After two weeks of helping the knights organise for the upcoming invasion, Alice decided to leave Centoria and take shelter at Rulid Village with a now-comatose Kirito due to growing talks among some of the knights and ascetics of seeking retribution from the boy for opposing the Axiom Church. However, as she had decided to hide her status as an Integrity Knight, Alice was denied permission to stay in the village due to her status as a former criminal. Instead, Alice received support from her sister Selka, as well as the former Gigas Cedar Carver Garitta, and constructed a cabin in the nearby forest to have a place to call home. One night five months later, Alice's humble abode was discovered by her former disciple Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-one during his investigation of reports of goblins and orcs sneaking in the area. Despite Eldrie's attempts to convince her to return to the Order to help with the coming invasion, Alice dismissed his pleas, citing concerns about her current lack of strength. Concerned that Bercouli would be the next one to visit her now that he would learn of her whereabouts, Alice decided to write farewell letters to Selka and Garitta the following day, before deserting her cabin after another night of sleep. That night, Alice discovered the village ablaze due to a raid from the Dark Territory when awoken by Kirito's unrest and Amayori's cries. Inspired by Kirito's attempt to reach his swords despite his damaged sense of self, Alice decided to arm herself and rush to the village's aid with her dragon Amayori to defend it. Non-canon Chronology. Hollow Realization. The One Who Resists God. While flying en route to exterminate a monster terrorizing the Human Empire, Alice and Amayori were suddenly surrounded by a bright light that rendered the Integrity Knight unconscious. When she regained her senses, she found herself in a forest in Ainground, with Amayori nowhere in sight. Concerned about her dragon and confused by her surroundings, the girl spent many days wandering the area and asking any player she encountered for help but did not find any sign of Amayori or anyone who knew the location of Centoria. Eventually, her search brought to the Temples of Eternity, where she found a small dragon being attacked by a monster, the latter of which she dispatched. As the dragon's eyes reminded her of Amayori and calmed her feelings over being lost and alone in an unfamiliar land, she decided to stay near and protect the youngling, a resolve that grew when the little dragon fell into an unwakeable sleep after being fed. For the next few days, Alice kept constant watch over the dragon youngling, whom she named Fuyuoi. During her vigil, she chased away several players that attempted to harm Fuyuoi; this incident was eventually brought to the attention of Kirito, who later arrived to investigate both the knight's presence and a quest supposedly related to the Temples. Though initially apprehensive of the swordsman, Alice was convinced of his unhostile intentions after Kirito explained he had also rescued a little dragon earlier and might know how to awaken Fuyuoi. Despite her extreme confusion over the unusual terminology the boy used, the girl managed to follow his directions in collecting and equipping the Ring of Destiny quest item Fuyuoi had dropped, before reluctantly accompanying him to the nearby village of Golgotha. Once they had spoken with the village elder, the swordswoman was instructed to feed Fuyuoi with a specific fruit dropped by a certain kind of monster, which she quickly focused on accomplishing. Over the next several days, Alice diligently followed the quest log in collecting foods with which to feed a growing Fuyuoi. On occasion, she would encounter Kirito while he was also gathering food for his dragon, the latter of whom she insisted he name Akinagi. During these meetings, they would challenge each other to competitions over who could acquire the quest food items faster, after which the victor would be treated to a meal at Golgotha Village. It was during these meals that the girl inadvertently revealed details that she came from a world different from or any other virtual reality but declined to explain herself further for the time being. When the quest log directed her to slay a beast lurking within the Temple sometime later, Alice escorted Fuyuoi to a hidden underground altar in the deepest level of the the building, where they were joined by Akinagi and Kirito alongside the beast. While the dragons engaged the beast, the knight and the swordsman defended themselves against a horde of summoned monsters. Though they succeeded in exterminating the minions, the beast suddenly unleashed a black mist that to their horror began absorbing Akinagi and Fuyuoi. Unwilling to attack the beast for fear of harming the dragons, Alice tearfully implored Fuyuoi to free himself and not leave her alone. Her plea was answered by a reassuring voice from the Rings of Destiny that apparently extracted the dragons from the beast, enabling the two to vanquish the monster. Afterward, they sadly bid Akinagi and Fuyuoi farewell before the dragons were transformed into guardian spirits of the Temple. Having traveled Golgotha Village to inform the elder of what had happened, Alice and Kirito learned the rings had been created by Akinagi's and Fuyuoi's parents to eventually reclaim the Temples from the beast. Additionally, the duo's parental love and protectiveness of the dragons had significantly and positively changed the outcome of the battle from what had originally been foretold. Greatly pleased by these revelations, the girl discussed them with Kirito and thanked him for guiding her on the quest, as well as the memories they had made along the way. Then she promised to explain her situation to the boy but first needed to rest and reflect on what they had experienced.

Alicia Klingerman was a supporting character in the War of the Underworld sub-arc of the Alicization Arc. She was the childhood friend of Gabriel Miller's, by whom she was murdered during the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. Appearance. Alicia had blue eyes and long brown hair reached her shoulders. She wore an orange dress with white straps and a red ribbon, white socks and brown shoes.

Alicia Rue is a supporting character in the Fairy Dance Arc and a reoccurring character throughout the Sword Art Online series. She is the Lord of the Cait Sith race in «ALfheim Online» (ALO). She was elected to the position of leader by popular vote. She formed an alliance with the Sylphs to finish the «Guardians of the World Tree». Appearance. Alicia Rue has a petite figure, wavy, blonde hair surrounding her triangular cat ears. She wears a one-piece armour that exposes her delicately-tanned skin. Claw weapons hang from the sides of her waist, while a colourful stripe near her hips emphasises her tail. She also wears a bell collar on her neck and a cape on the left arm with a red stripe through it near the front. Chronology. Fairy Dance Arc. During the Cait Sith meeting with the Sylphs at the Butterfly Valley, the negotiations were interrupted by Salamanders led by General Eugene. Just before they could attack, Kirito entered the stage and helped prevent a battle by bluffing about a Spriggan-Undine alliance and defeating Eugene in battle. After the Salamanders had left the area, Alicia complied with Sakuya's request for a Moonlight Mirror spell to communicate with Sigurd and banish him for his part in the ambush. Once Sakuya was done with the conversation, Alicia and Sakuya enquired about Kirito. Having learnt that he was not working for anyone, Alicia, as well as Sakuya, attempted to seduce Kirito into working for them. Though Kirito declined both offers by saying that he had to go to the World Tree. Before Alicia and Sakuya took their leave, they received a large sum of money from Kirito to quicken the preparations for the next attempt at clearing the Grand Quest. The next day, Alicia and the Cait Sith dragoons, along with Sylph forces, aided Kirito's ascension of the World Tree after using the collected funds to purchase armor of at least Ancient grade for all of her warriors. After Kirito managed to get through to the top of the tree, she withdrew her forces from the area. After the acquisition of ALO by Ymir and the release of a patch introducing New Aincrad, Alicia was seen with Sakuya and a few Cait Sith and Sylph warriors flying towards the floating castle. Girls Ops. Some time after the start of 2026, Alicia and Sakuya invited Leafa, Lisbeth, Lux, Silica, and Sinon to relax with them in Swilvane over some tea and sweets. During their conversation, the Lord wondered why Lux had not participated in the quest for Excalibur and became interested in learning the latter had been absent due to her embarrassing first meeting with Kirito. When Sakuya suddenly received another report of player killer activity in Sylph territory, Alicia became concerned and listened as Sakuya informed the other girls of the incidents. A few days later, Alica met Leafa, Lisbeth, and Silica in town, accompanied by Sinon as her bodyguard. The Cait Sith Lord explained that the partially effective attack on Sakuya had made the other leaders of the races apprehensive, and was inspiring more players to engage in player killing. Thus, Alicia was planning to hold a strategy meeting with the other Fairy Lords, starting with their allies, to discuss how to handle the bandits. When the bells began ringing, the Cait Sith leader left, promising to notify the girls of any new details. Mother's Rosario. Alicia took part in a barbecue hosted at Kirito and Asuna's Forest House. Additionally, she was one of over 1,000 ALO players present during Yuuki's final moments of life. Relationships. Sakuya. Alicia appears to be on friendly terms with Sakuya, as they appear to be quite familiar with each other regardless of their standing in the society of the game. Kirito. Alicia appears to have gained an interest in Kirito when he appeared during the alliance meeting to stop the Salamander Brigade from killing the leaders of the factions. She had attempted to seduce him and take him into the Cait Sith as a Mercenary. Leafa. They appear to know each other in game fairly well, as they seem somewhat familiar with each other. This may be due to Leafa's friendship with Sakuya. Skills. ALfheim Online. Magic. Alicia has been training in the use of darkness-attribute magic.

Alicization Arc is the in the Sword Art Online series. Introduction. By June, 2026, Kirigaya Kazuto (Kirito) was offered a job at a private enterprise, named Rath, by Kikuoka Seijirou, the VR crimes division member who Kazuto had been cooperating with ever since the end of the Sword Art Online incident. The job was to test out a 4th generation experimental FullDive machine, called the Soul Translator (STL), which ran on completely different principles than the FullDive machines before it. His job was seemingly simple: remain in continuous FullDive during the weekend and his memories of the testing would be blocked as a security measure. However, unbeknownst to him, the company was not actually testing the machine itself, but creating a special Bottom-Up type Artificial Intelligence (AI) for military use. For that reason, the company had copied the soul of a newborn baby and made it as a template for creating new AI, which would then be nurtured in a specialised virtual world, called Underworld, where time flows a thousand times faster than in the real world due to Fluctlight Acceleration. As the AIs created by Rath were far too compliant with laws to be used for the military, Rath brought Kazuto into the world with his memories restricted to test why the residents of Underworld were unable to break any laws. He lived in the world for nearly eleven years of accelerated time as a child again, until his influence resulted in one of the residents, a girl named Alice, to break one of the rules of the Taboo Index. After the conclusion of the experiment, Kazuto returned to the real world with the memories of his time in Underworld blocked. However, while escorting Yuuki Asuna home, he was attacked by Kanamoto Atsushi (Johnny Black), the last member of the Death Gun plot who managed to avoid being caught by the police. During their scuffle, Atsushi managed to inject Kazuto with the last syringe of, causing Kazuto's heart to stop. Although doctors were able to restart his heart, Kazuto's brain suffered major damage due to the lack of oxygen and thus he ended up in a coma. After Kazuto's body was secretly kidnapped by the Japan Self Defense Force (JSDF) and brought to a secret base in the Pacific Ocean, he was connected to one of the Soul Translators to treat his brain damage. Kazuto then woke up in Underworld, though with his memories of the real world still intact.

Alne was the largest city at the base of the World Tree in ALfheim Online and the capital city of Alfheim, until Yggdrasil City was established. It is known to be a neutral city and, even after the establishment of Yggdrasil City, acts as a main raiding base for the advanced dungeons on the Alne plateau as well as the central trading market for all races. Location. Due to its size, this city has been divided into five zones: North, South, West, East, and Central. The World Tree's Dome located in the Central Zone. The city also holds four dungeons located to the north, south, east and west of the city, with their deepest floors having stairs leading to ALO's most difficult dungeon, Jötunheimr. There is also a secret alley, which is not shown on the map, that leads to a locked wooden door, which can only be opened with a certain key, obtained after escaping Jötunheimr through said door. The door leads to a staircase leading to Jötunheimr. World Tree. Near the foot of the World Tree stands a gate that leads to the dungeon which leads to the top of the World Tree. Players must defeat the Guardian Knights guarding the inner gate to be able to pass through and complete the first Grand Quest to meet the Fairy King Oberon, who is supposed to grant the first successful fairy race the gift of eternal flight, but it is later revealed that the dungeon was not supposed to be beatable by the players, as even if by some chance a player would reach the inner gate, they would still not be able to enter through it without admin authority. After ALO was acquired by Ymir, an elevator connecting Alne to the newly established Yggdrasil City at the top of the Tree was created.

Amayori is a supporting character in the Alicization Arc. She is Alice Synthesis Thirty's dragon in Underworld. Appearance. Amayori is a gigantic, silver dragon with triangular scales adorning its entire body. She has two wings that tower like a couple of spires, a long neck and a long tail that draws an arc. She has a faintly bluish fuzz growing under her neck and has metal armour equipped on its chest and head when on duty. Personality. Amayori is a very loyal dragon. Despite being released from a binding art that kept her under control and being encouraged to return home, Amayori continued to stay with Alice. Background. Amayori was born in the flying dragon nest in the West Empire. At some point, a binding art was placed on her and she was assigned to serve as Alice's dragon. Chronology. Alicization Arc. Alicization Turning. On the 23rd Day of the Human Empire Calendar, Amayori and Alice arrived at the Sword Mastery Academy to arrest Eugeo and Kirito. Alice restrained the two criminals, then grabbed the chains extending from their back and attached them to Amayori's left and right legs respectively. After giving some time for Eugeo and Kirito to say their farewells to their valets, Alice had Amayori take off and fly to the Central Cathedral. Alicization Invading. After the fall of Quinella, Alice had Amayori take her to the remote northern region where Rulid Village was located. On the day Alice decided to build a log cabin and settle in, she released Amayori from a binding art placed on her and told her that she was free to return to the flying dragon nest in the west. However, Amayori refused to leave Alice and made a bed out of grass next to Alice's log cabins. For the following several months, she would fly out during daytime to play in the forest and catch fish in the lake, but would return to the cabin on every night. One night, Amayori and her elder brother Takiguri sensed each other's presence in the region and Takiguri landed near the cabin with his rider, Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-one. The next night, Amayori sensed a disturbance in Rulid Village and alerted Alice to an invasion from the Dark Territory. Deciding to save the villagers, Alice had Amayori fly her to the village. There, Alice saw that the villagers had not evacuated, so she had Amayori fly above the plaza and then asked her to standby, while she jumped off the dragon. Once the villagers were far away from centre of the plaza, Alice called her dragon to rain down fire on the invaders. Several moments later, Alice called her dragon again, but this time only to intimidate the invaders, as Amayori was not yet ready to fire another heat ray. A week after the end of the invasion, after fastening her belongings to Amayori's leg, Alice sat Kirito in Amayori's saddle then mounted the dragon herself and had Amayori fly towards the eastern skies. Alicization Awakening. After Alice was taken by Vecta, Amayori, alongside Takiguri and Hoshigami assisted the latter's master Bercouli Synthesis One in pursuing after them.

AmuSphere is a second generation FullDive console, co-developed by RECT Progress Inc., that is the successor to the NerveGear. Its successor, temporarily named as AmuSphere 2, is planned to be shown in the 2026 Tokyo Game Show and released to the market in 2027. Appearance. The AmuSphere is a helmet that consists of two metal overlapping rings. Safety Measures. The system has been modified to make it safer than its predecessor by changing the microwave transmitter to a low-frequency one and the incorporation of various sensors that continually monitor blood pressure and brain waves. If the person's condition becomes abnormal, a safety logout is provoked. This, by default, includes an option that automatically logs out a person if the avatar begins to fall asleep. Unlike the NerveGear, the AmuSphere is not equipped with an internal battery. In addition to other safety measures, the AmuSphere does not block out signals from the body to the extent of its predecessor, the NerveGear. Some players may rent a specialized room which blocks all external interference, designed to make the experience inside the virtual world all the more realistic. Usage. As with the NerveGear, it is recommended for the player to get into a comfortable position before beginning to use the device. Once the player has the device worn over the head in a comfortable position, the console can be activated by saying «Link Start». Imaginator. The is a widely used software on the AmuSphere. The software generates a virtual space for diving where the user may record a message, which can be compressed into mail format and sent to another user. When the receiver plays the file, the sender's recorded virtual body and spoken message would be reproduced. The program also allows conveying video, audio, and even the sense of touch. An incident occurred when a security loophole was found in the software. A certain virus-infected message would cause a preview of something erotic or gross to be forcefully opened in surround sound and colour when a user dived in with such an infected message in their inbox.

An Incarnation of the Radius was a monster developed by Argus to be the boss of the 100th Floor of Aincrad in the official version of Sword Art Online (SAO). However, when Kayaba Akihiko turned SAO into a death game, he intended to take the place of the final boss himself if the floor was reached, leaving the boss unused in the game. Sometime after SAO was cleared, the data for the boss was found by Professor Shigemura Tetsuhiro, who decided to reactivate the monster on the SAO server and use its language engine as the foundation for a Yuna Artificial Intelligence. On April 29, 2026, An Incarnation of the Radius was defeated by a group led by Kirito in order to prevent the professor from conducting a dangerous brain scan on the survivors of Sword Art Online at the New National Stadium. The monster had ten Hit Point bars. Appearance. An Incarnation of the Radius is a colossal monster that looks like both a goddess and a beast, as the monster is based on the goddesses mentioned in the Genesis of Aincrad lore. The monster has a white body, red eyes, a feminine face, and several red orbs on its head, which extends above and behind its body to waist length, forming six long, sword-like appendages with a red orb at the bulge on each of them. The boss has two arms, wielding a crimson sword in its right hand, and a spear with a red head and black handle in its left. The monster also wears a lavish, hakama-like piece of clothing from the waist down. The hakama is crimson with black lines at its lower part, dark with red lines at its middle and upper parts, with a golden decoration at its very top. Attack Patterns. An Incarnation of the Radius has several ordinary attacks, three special abilities, and a defensive technique. The boss's basic attacks consist of it using its sword, spear, or tentacles to attack at close range, or fire either lasers or missile-like projectiles to deal damage from a distance. The monster's first special attack consists of summoning the Black Great Holy Tree to execute a wide-ranged attack. Its second special attack involves summoning the White Great Holy Tree, the dew drops of which heal the monster; however, it is possible to interrupt this ability by hitting the monster before the dew drops. Its last special attack, called the Great Separation, causes the ground beneath the targeted player to be cut into a disk shape and sent flying into the air, before crumbling mid-air and causing the player to fall. Finally, the monster has a special defensive technique, wherein it summons six magic stones around its body to create a barrier for itself. Boss Battle. Summary. Agil, Kirito, Lisbeth, Silica, and Sinon descended to the Ruby Palace after being requested to defeat the boss by Yuna; however, the boss began attacking them before they could even land safely. Although the group managed to break the monster's shield and deal damage to it with a concentrated attack, despite being overwhelmed by the boss's offensive capabilities, An Incarnation of the Radius quickly used its self-healing ability to recover all the lost hit points, before using its black tree attack for a grand counterattack. Just as it seemed like the group would be annihilated by the various attacks the monster employed, Asuna joined the battle, piercing the monster's eyes and earning the group a moment of respite. Before the monster could return to its onslaught, Yui brought reinforcements to the battle from ALfheim Online and Gun Gale Online, including Leafa; Alicia Rue, Eugene, and Sakuya; Jun, Klein, Recon, and Siune; Behemoth and Yamikaze; as well as Dyne and Ginrou. With their combined power, the players managed to weaken the boss enough for Asuna and Kirito to kill it with their final attacks, Mother's Rosario and Starburst Stream respectively.

An Si-eun , known as in «ALfheim Online» (ALO), is a supporting character in Mother's Rosario. She was the second sub-leader of the «Sleeping Knights», a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. An Si-eun had played a variety of virtual reality games, including Insect Site, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where An Si-eun chose to be an Undine. Appearance. Real Life. An Si-eun wears glasses, and, having lost her hair to chemotherapy, wears a wig as well. ALfheim Online Avatar. An Si-eun's avatar has long, light-blue hair which is almost pure white, one of the most defining feature of Undine players. She also has calm deep-blue eyes shining radiantly beneath her drooping eyelashes, a long nose, lustrous lips and surprisingly slender body, all of which give off the feeling of an excellent Undine healer. In town, she wears light, blue ordinary clothes, but in battle, she wears an Ancient-level, cleric-styled, white and navy-blue robe, a hat which poofs out like a cake, and she carries a thin silver staff in her right hand. Personality. An Si-eun is kind at heart, but also somewhat sensitive and emotional. Si-eun is not as emotionally resilient as Yuuki, as she was ready to give up many times, but, after meeting her and learning that she had been going through the same pain all her life, Si-eun forced herself to continue. Background. Since her father is a Korean resident of Japan while her mother is Japanese, An Si-eun learnt to speak both Korean and Japanese from her parents. As with the other members of the Sleeping Knights, An Si-eun was diving into virtual worlds to improve her life quality, since she was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia. She was treated with chemotherapy and became better, but after a year, she was sick again. As she was not compatible for a bone marrow transplant, she was given drugs and salvage chemotherapy to ease the pain. An Si-eun also has a brother, who accompanied her to Yuuki's memorial service, but waited outside at her request. Chronology. Mother's Rosario. An Si-eun was first introduced in an inn on the 27th Floor of Aincrad as a member of the Sleeping Knights guild. She acted as a support player to her party during battles, not only healing, but also casting buffs on them. With Asuna's help, they managed to defeat the floor's boss. After the guild disbanded, Siune was the only one who faced Asuna and asked her not to look for them. After Asuna met Yuuki at the hospital, Siune, along with the other members, returned to ALO and cleared the 28th and 29th Floors. Throughout February, Si-eun received less medication, and while her doctors told her that her condition was improving, she believed she would soon die. The day after Yuuki passed away, the doctors informed An Si-eun that she had completely recovered and she was discharged from hospital. A week later, after Yuuki's funeral had ended, An Si-eun approached Asuna, introducing herself and revealing that she has recovered. She revealed that she felt guilty about outliving Yuuki and the other members of the Sleeping Knights, but was comforted when Asuna said that thanks to Yuuki, she now knew what it meant to live life to the fullest. An Si-eun then thanked Asuna for making Yuuki so happy, and was pleased with the thought that it may be a while before the Sleeping Knights were reunited in death. Doctor Kurahashi soon arrived and congratulated An Si-eun on her recovery, saying that Yuuki would have been pleased with it. Alicization Arc. Alicization Awakening. Siune, along with the remaining members of the Sleeping Knights, was among the 2,000 Japanese players who helped the residents of Underworld defend against Gabriel's army of converted players during the War of the Underworld. When PoH gathered an army of Korean players, Siune used Korean to communicate with the Korean players to warn them that they had been deceived. Although she managed to get several players to listen to her, they were interrupted by PoH, who attacked a player listening to her and began persuading the others to continue fighting. When Siune attempted to plead to the Koreans to believe her, she was struck by PoH's cleaver and kicked to the ground by the leader of the Korean group the moment a group of Chinese players broke the ceasefire.

Ancient Forest The is a forest dungeon located in the north-eastern area of the Sylph zone and the south-western corner of the realm of Alfheim in ALfheim Online. Description. The Ancient Forest is a large forest that consists of large trees that are hundreds of years old. They are covered in fungus while the foliage in the forest is so dense that it is impossible to see far. A river runs in zigzags throughout the forest. Numerous flying islands, some of which have waterfalls, hover over the forest. Although most of the forest is on a plain terrain, some areas are hilly or mountainous. Chronology. Fairy Dance Arc. On January 20, 2025, Sigurd's party of Sylph players, including Leafa and Recon, travelled through the Ancient Forest while returning to the Sylph territory from a neutral zone where they had been hunting. However, they were attacked en route by eight Salamanders. After some time, Leafa and Recon managed to temporarily run away from the five remaining Salamanders, but due to Recon's vertigo slowing them down, the Salamanders easily caught up. After a battle, two more Salamanders and Recon were killed and Leafa had to land due to flying for too long. Meanwhile, due to Leafa and Kirito sharing the same IP address, the latter ended up entering the game at the forest, instead of the Spriggan starting zone as intended. After browsing through his window and confirming that the logout button was there, he discovered that his stats were identical to those that he had in Sword Art Online. He also found that he had a lot of unidentified items, among which he discovered Yui, and thus materialised her. After a conversation, Yui informed him of a battle taking place in the forest and Kirito set out to take a look. There he easily dispatched two of the Salamanders, allowing the remaining Salamander, Kagemune, to escape. After Kirito's conversation with Leafa, they both agreed to travel to Swilvane for Leafa to treat Kirito to a drink for saving her. The next day, on January 21, 2025, Kirito and Leafa returned to the Ancient Forest en route to the Legrue Corridor. On their way, they battled with several Evil Glancers and stopped near the edge of the forest to rest and rotate to tend to their real life needs before continuing on their journey. Once both of them took their turns, they proceeded out of the forest and towards the Legrue Corridor.

Andrew Gilbert Mills , known as in Sword Art Online (SAO), ALfheim Online (ALO), and Project Alicization, is a supporting character in the Aincrad Arc and a reoccurring character throughout the Sword Art Online series. He was one of the 10,000 players who were trapped in «Sword Art Online» (SAO), where he was a veteran axe-wielder and a merchant who owned a shop in Algade, a city on the 50th Floor of «Aincrad». After returning to the real world in the aftermath of the Sword Art Online incident, Andrew began playing ALfheim Online (ALO) as a Gnome. In real life, Andrew manages the «Dicey Café» with the help of his wife. Appearance. Real Life / Sword Art Online. Andrew is a massive and bulky African-American man with a brown goatee and brown eyes. He is bald and wears two silver earrings on his left ear in both Sword Art Online and the real world. At the beginning of the Sword Art Online official service, Agil wore a breastplate over a sleeveless shirt, light brown pants, and fur boots. By the end of the Sword Art Online Incident, he wore jungle green robes and gray armor while in combat. In the real world, Andrew wears a white shirt and a dark gray apron over pants of the same color. Kirigaya Kazuto also commented that he is as large in real life as he is in-game. ALfheim Online. In ALfheim Online, Agil's appearance is similar to his Sword Art Online avatar, except his robes are dark moss green. Personality. Agil is a very friendly and helpful person who is always looking out for others. He is also trustworthy and reliable, shown when he defended the beta testers against Kibaou, gave Kirito a place to stay, and helped players on lower floors. He also can be a leader on the battlefield and will help his comrades and friends no matter the cost. Although Agil acted as though he only cared about making money, Kirito commented that he had spent all of his helping mid-level players level up. Background. Although African-American by ethnicity, Andrew's parents loved Japan and had him in Ueno, Tokyo. He opened his coffee shop-bar in Okachimachi at the age of twenty-five. Among his customers was a woman named Trish, who was a foreigner living nearby. She had many of the same interests as Andrew, and they eventually got married. Afterwards, Andrew became trapped in SAO for two years. When he returned, he was surprised to find the shop had been saved and maintained by his wife contrary to his expectations. Chronology. Aincrad Arc. Aria of a Starless Night. Agil was first seen defending the beta testers from Kibaou, who was saying that they were the cause of the two-thousand deaths. He showed Kibaou «Argo's Strategy Guide: First Floor Boss edition» and said that not all of the beta testers were to blame, as some of them gave out free information which could be obtained for free in any non-player shop. In the boss fight, he and his party helped Kirito and Asuna beat the boss. He also showed capable leadership during the fight, being able to safely lead his party without any casualties. Concerto of Black and White. On December 15, 2022, at five o'clock, Agil and his friends participated in the first strategy meeting for the 3rd Floor. Hearing that Lind was forbidding Kirito and Asuna from joining the same guild, Agil expressed exasperation. When Lind shifted his focus to Agil's group, inquiring about their intentions of joining either of the two main guilds, all four of them declined, as they seemingly desired to create a guild of their own. Scherzo of Deep Night. Agil and his guild agreed to join Kirito in defeating the 5th Floor boss to obtain the Flag of Valor before the Aincrad Liberation Squad could, in order to maintain the fragile balance between the ALS and the Dragon Knights Brigade. October, 2024. In October 2024, Agil was visited by Kirito with a piece of Ragout Rabbit's Meat that the boy wanted to sell to the merchant. November, 2024. Agil later closed his shop and came to the 75th Floor's boss battle to aid in the boss fight. Prior to Kirito's rematch with Heathcliff, Kirito thanked Agil for always helping and supporting the mid-level players of the game in order to reach the front lines. After Sword Art Online was cleared, the man was logged out of the game along with the other 6,146 surviving players. Fairy Dance Arc. To Andrew's surprised relief, he found Trish had been able to keep the Dicey Cafe from closing during his two years of absence. Having resumed his management of the shop, the man was contacted by Kirigaya Kazuto (Kirito) on December 20, 2024, during which they exchanged email addresses. Sometime in January 2025, Andrew discovered a screenshot taken inside ALfheim Online showing a girl resembling Asuna trapped in a cage. As Yuuki Asuna (Asuna) and 300 other players had not regained consciousness even after the completion of SAO, he sent a copy of the image to Kazuto on the morning of January 20. When the boy arrived at the Dicey Cafe that same day demanding more information, the man briefly explained the mechanics of ALO and how the screenshot had been taken in-game at the World Tree. Having given Kazuto a physical copy of the game so he could investigate, Andrew exhorted him to rescue Asuna if the girl really was her, so they could finally put an end to the Sword Art Online Incident. Although he did not play ALfheim Online during the few days during which Kirito saved Asuna, he played ALO later as a Gnome axe-wielder. He even played with Kirigaya Suguha, Kazuto's sister. Andrew's cafe was also used for the celebration of completing SAO and the rescue of Asuna. Many remaining SAO players came to the celebration, including the Aincrad Liberation Force's (The Army) leader, Thinker, as well as his wife, Yulier. Extra Edition. Agil joined Kirito and and the others in the «Deep Sea Plunderers» quest to fulfill Yui's wish of seeing a whale.

Angel The Angel refers to one of the NPCs which are part of the «Ring of Angel's Whisper» quest. Appearance. The Angel appears to be around the same height as Leafa, she has two wings on her back, and long hair. In her goddess form, she wears a dress decorated with flowers and a tiara decorated with wings and flowers, and no longer has wings. Personality. Her personality is one that is genuinely cold (and slightly hostile) towards people, though it is said that later on she would show a softer side of herself. Thus, she is a classical example of a tsundere. Background. The character was originally created by the Cardinal System's Automatic Quest Generation Function for the «Ring of Angel's Whisper» quest in «Sword Art Online». Some time after the introduction of New Aincrad to ALfheim Online, the angel was imported from Sword Art Online along with the quest. The angel is said to have been betrayed by humans in the past, which is why she is generally cold to other people. During the quest, she sets several challenges to the players to obtain "eternal bonds". When the Angel's ring quest was adapted to ALfheim Online, the Angel background was altered: she was revealed to have been a goddess who had disguised herself as an angel in search of eternal bonds. Chronology. Girls Ops. After logging into ALO, the girls Silica, Lisbeth and Leafa headed to Angel's Rose Garden to start the quest. There they met the Angel, who coldly told them to get a move on and complete the next task. After reaching the Angel's Rose Garden after battling the huge rabbit monster, Silica, Lisbeth, Leafa and Kuro found the garden destroyed by a giant. After they found a feather, they used it and the Angel appeared, telling them that they had failed the test. She then disappeared abruptly as she was telling them more.

Angel's Rose Garden Angel's Rose Garden refers to the location where the quest that rewards the «Ring of Angel's Whisper» is started. It is also the home of the Angel. Chronology. Girls Ops. The Rose Garden is seen in the 2nd chapter of Volume 1. However, it was destroyed by a giant.

Anneal Blade An is a one-handed sword that is obtained as a reward for the «Secret Medicine of the Forest» quest in Sword Art Online (SAO). Up to eight enhancements can be attempted on the «Anneal Blade». Background. The «Anneal Blade» is a long sword which was an heirloom in the family of a Non-Player Character (NPC) woman residing in the village of Horunka.

Ant Hill Ant Hill refers to a dungeon on the 46th Floor of Aincrad. Description. The Ant Hill is a cliff that is surrounded by many caves, from where the dungeon's signature ant monsters spawn from. These ant monsters have a high attack power, but have a very low HP and defense stat. It is a popular location for gaining experience points, and due to its high popularity, a party is only allowed one hour of experience gain. Chronology. Aincrad Arc. Red-Nosed Reindeer. Kirito had been at this dungeon since 8pm that day to level up. After one of the one-hour time limits, Klein approached Kirito and noted that the time was 2am, and that Kirito had stayed at the dungeon for 6 hours. Kirito nonchalantly replied that he rested within the two-hour intervals until he could start hunting again, and finally admitted that he had reached Level 69 that day. Klein asked about why he was leveling up so hard. Kirito then inquired if Klein was asking about him going to fight Christmas Flag Mob on Christmas Eve in 5 days. He then explained that he had bought Argo's information about Klein buying the information that Kirito was going to fight the Flag Mob. The conversation then deviated to the revival item, with Klein starting to object that «death» in the game was probably not true for real death. Kirito told Klein to shut up, and further told him about pursuing the small chance of saving one of the deceased. Klein then noted that it had been a month since Kirito's former guild, the Moonlit Black Cats, had perished. Kirito appeared to keep holding the guilt upon himself, and that he would keep pursuing the chance of retrieving the revival item. Kirito then asked Klein what his reason for getting the revival item was, and Klein revealed that he too had lost a friend. The conversation ended with Klein saying that if Kirito died a brave, he would not use the revival item on him. Klein's guild never returned to the Ant Hill after that encounter. Kirito trained for four more days, until he reached Level 70, and used a Teleport Crystal to travel to the frontline city on the 49th Floor.

Anti-Criminal Code Effect Area The, usually referred to as the, is a special anti-criminal protection system within most town areas in Sword Art Online. Mechanics. The range of the «Area» extends from the city's centre to its gates, from the street level of the city to the base of the next floor. The moment someone moves into this three-dimensional space, the «Anti Criminal Code» will immediately take effect, with an «Inner Area» notification appearing in the player's visual display; conversely, leaving the space will have an «Outer Field» warning materialize within their view. This «Code» protects the players within the radius of the «Area» from any possible source of damage, including the damage caused by other players; any attack would be blocked by a purple system barrier, preventing any damage to the Hit Points (HP) of the targeted player. However, the «Area» does not stop the impact of the blow, thus players hit by other players still suffer an unpleasant feedback, despite their HP not decreasing. Moreover, the «Area» also negates the effects of any poisonous items and damage over time effects, though the piercing damage on armor and equipment would continue to apply. Duels. As a direct act of violence cannot be performed within the «Area», the only way to deal damage to another player within the «Area» is by starting a duel or accepting a duel request, which will cause the «Area» effect on the players involved to be lifted temporarily. This is also the only known method of killing a player within the «Area», though it may be possible to fake a murder within the «Area» aside from duels by teleporting a dying player into the «Area» before they scatter into polygons, though that is highly improbable to do. Orange Players. The «Area» also prevents Orange Players from entering a settlement protected by the «Area». If an Orange Player attempted to enter such a settlement, they would be immediately attacked by a large number of powerful NPC guards. The only way for a criminal to safely enter such an area would be to change the colour of their Cursor back to green. As it becomes exceedingly difficult to complete the quest to revert the colour of one's cursor for repeated instances of murdering players, notorious Player Killers can never restore their cursor back to green, preventing them from ever infiltrating a settlement protected by the «Area». Loopholes. The system does, however, have some loopholes. One such loophole is sending a Total Loss Mode duel request to a sleeping opponent and then moving their fingers to press the "OK" button to accept the duel and lift the «Area»'s protection. Another method is carrying an unconscious body out of the «Area» with a stretcher item and then attacking them where the «Area» effect no longer applies.

Arashi is one of the members of Dyne's squadron in Gun Gale Online. Appearance. Gun Gale Online Avatar. Arashi wears brown pants and top, with an armoured plate guarding the area between his chest and stomach. He also wears dark brown gloves, sunglasses and a helmet, which is decorated with a black feather. Arashi is armed with an «M4 Carbine». Chronology. Phantom Bullet Arc. Arashi took part in an attempt to ambush a Mob-hunting squadron in a wasteland field. Arashi was in charge of scouting for the enemy while the others chatted. After some time, Arashi alerted the others that the squadron was coming. After Dyne observed the squadron and told Sinon which player she should take out with her sniper, Arashi and the others proceeded to get closer to the squadron to be ready to engage them. After Dyne's squadron found out that the Mob hunting squadron had hired a bodyguard, named Behemoth, who was using a GE M134 Minigun, Arashi and the others tried holding on to their position, but were gradually pushed back. When Sinon came to help, Arashi was told to provide covering fire with his M4, while Jin and Miso attacked from the left, and Sinon and Dyne attacked from the right. Arashi was later seen spending time with other members of Dyne's squadron while Dyne was waiting for the start of the third Bullet of Bullets

Argus was the corporation that produced the world's first VRMMO game, Sword Art Online, and the «NerveGear». Kayaba Akihiko was an employee of this company, having become the manager of the 3rd developing branch when he was in his second year at Teito University. Chronology. Aincrad Arc. Argus was the gaming corporation that produced «Sword Art Online» and «NerveGear» under the direction of Kayaba Akihiko, who had long been employed as one of its game designers. The fifth floor basement contained the data for the world of Aincrad. When Kayaba Akihiko effectively trapped 10,000 players in the game, many of the deceased players' family members sued the company. Argus then filed bankruptcy, selling their rights to the Cardinal System to RECT Progress Inc., which used it to create ALfheim Online.

Argyro's Sheet is an item found in a storeroom in a sunken dungeon on the 4th Floor of Aincrad. The item is generated as part of the Shipwright of Yore quest. Description. Official Description. <tabber> English = A cloth made of silk from a rare aquatic spider. This cloth will hide anything it covers, but only in a place surrounded by water. Japanese = 水中で暮らす珍しい蜘蛛の系で織った布。周囲を水に囲まれた場所でだけ、この布で覆ったものを見えなくすることができる </tabber> Usage Notes. The instant the cloth covers something, the sheet changed to the colour of the surface of the water, making it hardly possible to see the hidden objects; however, enough light passes through the sheet for people hiding under it to see through it. The durability of the item decreases by approximately ten percent per five minutes when the item’s ability is activated. The lost durability can be restored by repairing it using the Tailoring skill.

Armachthys An is a monster found in the Undersea Temple in ALfheim Online. Appearance. An Armachthys is a large, black with a large gray spot fish that has a pair of large fins in its front, three more pairs of fins on its bottom side, with the last pair being larger than the first two, and two more large fins on its top side. The monster's head is covered in tough bone armour with a horn sticking out of its top. There is a small opening in the armour at the top of its head which may be its weak point. The monster has two bright red eyes and sharp teeth with two large fangs at the center of its jaw. Abilities. Due to the monster’s armoured head, it is practically impossible to harm it from the front. The monster usually attacks by charging at its opponent and ramming them with its armoured head, but it may also start swimming fast in circles to form a whirlpool that sucks in players and leaves them off-balance. Chronology. Extra Edition. An Armachthys emerged from a trap in the Undersea Temple after Kirito and Klein accidentally fell into it and barely managed to swim out of it. Kirito tried to attract its attention while Klein, Agil, Silica and Lisbeth attacked it from the sides while it was busy and Asuna and Leafa supported the party with magic. However, in the midst of the battle, Leafa decided to join in on the melee, but this caused the Armarchthys to become aggravated at her and respond with its whirlpool ability that sucked in Leafa and made her almost fall into the trap. While the monster was still maintaining its whirlwind, Kirito used its force to reach the ceiling and attack the monster from the top, killing it by hitting the chink in its armour.

Armament Full Control Art The is a super high-ranking Sacred Arts ritual that is used to boost the offensive power of a Divine Object-class weapon by linking with the true essence of the weapon. Mechanics. As all Divine Object-class weapons strongly inherit the properties of the object that served as its nucleus in the form of memories, the Armament Full Control Art may be used to tap into the parameters inherited from the base material, thus increasing the power of the weapon in the form of special abilities. The ability acquired through the ritual depends solely on how the caster pictures the released form of the weapon. The ritual is divided into two phases, the «strengthening» and the «releasing» phases. Strengthening Phase. The first phase of the «Armament Full Control Art», called the «strengthening» phase, is the partial awakening of the weapon's memories, which manifest as a new offensive ability for the weapon. The phase, like all Sacred Arts, requires chanting a system command that begins with ""System Call!", while the command itself can range from about 25 to 30 words and is customised for each weapon based on their inherited parameters and the chosen ability. The general syntax of the command is: The «Life» of the weapon decreases greatly every time the command is used and the power of the ritual is determined by the caster's ability to imagine the released form of the weapon. Releasing Phase. The second phase of the ritual, called the «releasing» phase, is a command that releases all of the memories of the weapon, unleashing all of its rampant power. Memories unleashed with this phase become uncontrollable to the caster and might even engulf the caster himself. Unlike the other commands, this phase does not require the caster to say the starting phrase, ""System Call!", as the second phase continues directly from the first phase and thus only requires saying "Release recollection"" after the first phase is activated for the second phase to be initiated.

Artificial Intelligence Artificial Intelligence (or A.I.), in the field of gaming and computer science, refers to the intelligence of the machines and the effort to re-create human-like intelligence in Non-Player Characters (NPCs). In Sword Art Online, the system is generally known for having a mixture of NPCs with very advanced A.I. and NPCs with very poor A.I. Sword Art Online Universe. «Top-Down AI». In the Sword Art Online Universe, a Top-Down AI refers to artificial intelligence built from a program atop an existing computer architecture. NPCs in SAO have top-down AI, meaning they are scripted to act in an exact certain way in response to a very specific stimulus. When speaking to Top-Down NPCs in a quest, a player must listen to the NPC through the entire duration of the speech. If not, the quest does not proceed, as the Top-Down AI is scripted in a very basic, simplistic fashion. Top-Down AIs work from an answer, and wait to respond to a question. Some AI can even be scripted and modeled to mimic human behavior, to almost be indistinguishable from a human. These AI simply have more data to process, and have learned to mimic behavior, to fit a personality. Yui is a prime example of a very advanced Top-Down AI. If a player tries to touch an NPC in any way, they will momentarily receive a warning message for harassing the NPC and will get shocked. This is to prevent players from moving them to a player's desired location or sexually harassing the NPC. This, however, does not happen to Yui, as her position in-game is not fixed to any specific location. In Sword Art Online, NPCs can be killed much like players, but unlike players, NPCs will respawn after twenty-four hours. However, there are two exceptions. First, «Tamed Monsters», such as Pina, turn into a «Heart» upon their death and can only be resurrected with the «Pneuma Flower», but this can only be done within three days after its death, otherwise the heart becomes «Remains», in which case, it cannot be revived at all, effectively making the Tamed Monster permanently dead. Second, Yui is classified as an «Immortal Object» and therefore cannot be harmed at all. «Bottom-Up AI». Bottom-Up AI are AI that work in the opposite manner of a Top-Down AI, as they compute an answer when a question is given, rather than having a preset answer to a desired question. Unlike Top-Down AI, who learn by the "Ask A, so answer with B" method, Bottom-Up AI learn through "Learn B, and answer when asked A". According to Kirito, this is what a true artificial intelligence should be like. In the Sword Art Online Universe, the only known way to create a Bottom-Up AI is through the cloning of a human Fluctlight - creating an Artificial Fluctlight. An Artificial Fluctlight is the cloned quantum field (soul) of a newborn baby, which is later nurtured in a VR world.

Asada Shino , known as in «Gun Gale Online» (GGO), ALfheim Online (ALO), as well as «Project Alicization», where she had temporarily used the account, is the deuteragonist of the Phantom Bullet Arc and one of the main characters in the War of the Underworld sub-arc of the Alicization Arc. She is a skilled Virtual Reality game player, who began playing Gun Gale Online based on the suggestion from her friend, Shinkawa Kyouji, in an attempt to overcome her trauma concerning guns. After the events of the Phantom Bullet Arc, she began playing «ALfheim Online» as a Cait Sith archer, capable of hitting targets two hundred meters away with a bow that should only be able to shoot arrows accurately at a maximum distance of one hundred meters. Appearance. Real World. Similar to both of her VRMMO game avatars, Shino has thin hair tied in small ribbons by the sides of her face, with the back cut short. Unlike her avatars, Shino has dark hair in real life. She also wears a pair of half-rimmed glasses with oval-shaped lenses. Her skin is pale and she has black eyes. She has a black spot on her right hand, left there by gunpowder from the time she fired a gun in real life. Gun Gale Online. Shino's avatar has thin, pale blue swaying hair that was casually short, but there was a tuft of hair tied up on both sides of her forehead, and indigo colored eyes. Her combat attire consists of a desert-colored military jacket, bulletproof armor of the same color, and combat boots, as well as a white muffler around her neck. ALfheim Online. Shino's avatar maintains her blue hair from GGO, yet holds the appearance of a Cait Sith, her chosen race, with blue ears and a matching tail. She wears a green coat with white chest armor, a black choker and a belted quiver across her shoulders. Project Alicization. Shino's avatar as Sun Goddess Solus has water-colored hair and blue eyes. She wears ornate azure armor and a long white skirt. Background. In late December 2010, Shino and her parents were involved in a motor vehicle collision on a secluded mountain road, which resulted in the death of her father as no help could arrive on time. Due to Shino's mother becoming traumatized by the ordeal, the girl started living with her grandparents and decided to become strong enough to always protect her mother. In late 2020, Shino was accompanying her mother at a post office, when a man armed with a Type 54 "Black Star" handgun entered the building, demanding money from the staff. The moment the robber threatened to shoot Shino's mother if his demands were not met, the girl wrested the pistol from him and pulled the trigger, resulting in the man's death. As a result of the incident, Shino developed an intense fear of guns and a slight apprehension of men, leading to her being ostracized throughout elementary and middle school. To escape the unwanted attention, Shino desired to move far outside her hometown. As Shino's grandparents forbade her from working immediately after finishing middle school, the girl settled for entering a fairly well-known high school in the Tokyo neighborhood where she had used to live with her parents. In June, 2025, Shino met a boy named Kyouji while reading a book about guns in a local library there, which led to her being introduced to Gun Gale Online by the boy when she heard that the gun she had used in the post office incident was present in the game. Having created an avatar called Sinon for Gun Gale Online, Shino became very invested in the game as her way of attempting to overcome her trauma with guns. In September, 2025, Shino triggered a trap while navigating a dungeon alone, which led to her encountering a powerful boss. By sniping it for countless hours from outside its attack range, she was able to obtain the rare PGM Ultima Ratio Hecate II anti-materiel rifle as a reward for defeating the boss. Personality. Calm and cool are two words that best describe Sinon's personality. In battle and most of the time in the game, she keeps a cool head. It is actually said that Kirito is the first one to make her extremely angry. Despite all this, Sinon, while perhaps hard to approach, is generally a friendly person and does not mind helping others. Shino, however, can be a fragile-minded character. This is due to her childhood incident that involved her killing a robber. If someone were to act as if they were shooting her in real life Shino would have a nervous breakdown and be on the verge of collapsing. People have used this to take advantage of Shino before. Not only this, but the guilt of taking another's life haunts Shino the same way killing Laughing Coffin members haunts Kazuto. After the Death Gun Incident, Shino has made progress with handling her trauma, as she did not have any serious reactions to seeing a model gun when Endou threatened to shoot her with one, and was even able to use it while feigning that she was not affected by it. Shino is shown to have an uncommonly kind heart. Not only was she willing to forgive Shinkawa Kyouji, but still cared for him as a friend to the extent that she resolved to visit him in prison to try and help, if not save him as a person. Chronology. Phantom Bullet Arc. At around sunset in Gun Gale Online on December 7, 2025, Sinon, as a recent member of a player killing squadron led by Dyne, was waiting in ambush for the arrival of a monster hunting squadron. Ignoring the other players' conversations, she focused on gathering enough information on them to assist her in defeating them easily someday. When their targets finally arrived around 2,500 meters within range twenty minutes later, the sniper used her Hecate's scope to examine their prey. Noticing the group had a new member who was wearing a large cloak, Sinon suggested sniping him first due to her unease about the man but reluctantly acquiesced to Dyne's order to prioritize on eliminating the enemy squadron's Minimi user. As the other members of her team moved into position for an ambush, Sinon spent the following several minutes maintaining her own position and preparing mentally for the battle. Once Dyne's squadron was ready and gave her the order to begin, she successfully sniped the Minimi user, before immediately turning her sights to the cloaked man. However, as her new target dodged her next shot and her position was revealed, Sinon switched to the role of an observer. To her surprise, the girl witnessed the cloaked player removing his mantle and thus revealing a GE M134 Minigun in his possession, which he used to effortlessly annihilate one of her squad members. Struck by the minigun wielder's confident smile during his counterattack, as well as how he had calmly evaded her shot, Sinon vowed to defeat the man in order to strengthen herself, as she raced to regroup with her team. Dodging the enemy team's gunfire, Sinon rejoined her squadron, where she was informed of the identity of the minigun user, Behemoth. Sensing Behemoth's ammunition was nearing depletion, she proposed the idea that the minigun user might hesitate in his assault if they all launched a simultaneous counterattack on him from multiple directions. Once their plan was enacted, Sinon evaded the enemy squadron's salvo and fired a shot at Behemoth, which only succeeded in destroying the man's goggles. As the girl steeled herself for the minigunner's impending retaliation, she was saved at the last second by Dyne, who managed to detonate a plasma grenade before being defeated. Taking advantage of the dust cloud generated by the grenade, Sinon rushed to a nearby building and climbed the stairs within. Upon reaching the end of the stairs a few floors up, she approached a window where she could prepare to take aim without drawing attention for several seconds. Due to Behemoth having predicted her movements, however, Sinon was forced to jump from the window when he launched a volley at her. Despite losing a leg, the sniper managed to position herself directly above the man, where the minigun was unable to reach, and fired a decisive shot that defeated her opponent. Two days later, after a typical day at school, Shino went shopping at around 15:30 on December 9, whereupon she was accosted by Endou and her cohorts, three fellow students whom Shino used to be friends with until she discovered that they had only been exploiting her. When the trio demanded ten thousand yen from Shino to supposedly pay for their train fare, the girl refused to give them any money, prompting Endou to retaliate by imitating a gun with her hand. Although Shino was rendered helpless by almost suffering a panic attack due to the gesture, a timely arrival and intervention from her friend Kyouji forced the bullies to flee the area. Thankful for his assistance, she accepted her friend's offer to treat her to a drink at a nearby cafe, where they discussed her recent victory over Behemoth in GGO, as well as the upcoming Bullet of Bullets. Having returned to her apartment later that day, Shino decided to test herself by handling the Procyon SL real-world model gun she had received from Zaskar as a prize for reaching twenty-second place in the second Bullet of Bullets two months prior, hoping that her encounters with Behemoth and Endou had allowed her to make progress in her endeavour to overcome her fear of guns. However, holding the toy gun triggered another panic attack, to her dismay. Believing that winning the Bullet of Bullets would be the key to healing her psychological scars, she logged into GGO once again. Sometime after 13:00 several days later on December 13, Shino logged into Gun Gale Online to register for the Bullet of Bullets (BoB) tournament. En route to the Governor's Office of SBC Glocken, however, she was suddenly approached by a feminine-looking player who asked her for directions. Assuming the player was a girl who had just started playing the game, Sinon empathetically helped them purchase their equipment. Once they were finished with the beginner's shopping, the two managed to reach the Governor's Office to register for the tournament on time, despite only having ten minutes before the Bullet of Bullets registration deadline arrived at 15:00, by renting a three-wheeled buggy. Upon the pair completing their registration for the tournament, Sinon led the new player to the changing room to prepare for the preliminaries by equipping their gear. When Sinon started changing her attire, however, she learnt from the beginner's belated self-introduction that he was actually a male, and thus she slapped him in embarrassment. Irritated at being deceived and at herself for lowering her guard, the girl had Kirito promise her that he would survive until the final match in the preliminary rounds of their block, where she would defeat him on the battlefield. Upon returning from her first battle, Sinon found a shaken Kirito already sitting in the waiting room after achieving victory against his opponent. Annoyed at seeing him in such a weak state, Sinon slammed her fist on his shoulder as she reminded him about his promise. To the girl's shock, however, her hand was suddenly grabbed by the boy dragged to his chest. As the state the boy was in reminded her of her own trauma, the two of them stayed in this position until Kirito was teleported to his next match. After defeating Stinger in her semi-final match and thus obtaining the right to participate in the main tournament the next day, Sinon was teleported to the «Intercontinental Highway» stage to take part in a bonus friendly match against Kirito, the other victor of the semi-finals. Taking position at a bus, the girl planted herself near an open window and scoped with her Hecate, only to discover Kirito slowly approaching her position with his head down and no will to fight. Angered by this, Sinon shot at Kirito several times, but missed each round. She then ran out to meet him and demand an answer as to why he would not fight her. After remembering how he disliked his opponents dropping the fight, Kirito asked her for another chance and proposed to have a duel version battle, which Sinon accepted. Sinon and Kirito lined up and got ready, with Kirito throwing a bullet into the air, waiting for the bullet to hit the ground. As soon as the bullet hit the ground, Sinon shot, but Kirito was able to slice the bullet in half and get to her, asking her to resign as he did not like to cut girls. The next day, on December 14, three and a half hours before the start of the Bullet of Bullets finals, Shino complained to her friend Shinkawa Kyouji about Kirito, stating that Kirito infuriates her. Kyouji commented on how she was acting, saying that he had never seen her bad-mouth someone so much, as she had never really taken interest in anyone. Later on, she returned home and Dived into GGO before the BoB finals started. After she Dived in, Sinon noticed the betting area, and, looking at both hers and Kirito's odds of winning, noticed that both hers and Kirito's odds were quite high. She then met Spiegel, Kyouji's GGO avatar, who started to confess his feelings for her. She stopped him from doing so, telling him she needed to concentrate for the finals. She then met Kirito, who was also on his way to register for the finals, and then gave him information on how the BoB finals worked, and how the thirty participants had to work with it. Kirito also asked her which of the players in the finals she did not know, to which she named, «Pale Rider» and «Sterben». While they were talking about Kirito's reasons for wanting to know who they were, Sinon worked out that Kirito was one of the survivors from Sword Art Online (SAO). As they left to get ready for the tournament, Sinon told Kirito that she would repay him for the humiliation he caused her in the Semi-Finals with interest, pointing her finger into his back as if holding a gun to him before she left Kirito. Nearly thirty minutes into the tournament, Sinon was in a sniping position, watching a player run, noticing he had no weak points due to his heavy armor. But she then noticed he had Plasma Grenades on his belt, which she calmly aimed at and shot, reducing the opponents Hit Points (HP) to zero. Sinon then picked her Hecate up and ran into shrubs due to her position most likely having been given away after her shot. When she stopped to check the Satellite Scan Terminal, she noticed that there were three other players nearby: «Dyne», «Pale Rider» and «Lion King Richie». She chose to leave Richie alone, and watch Dyne and Pale Rider who were nearby and were most likely running towards the river. As Sinon watched Dyne and Pale Rider, she felt a presence behind her, and turned around to see Kirito, with his gun held up to show that he wouldn't shoot her. He stated that he wished to watch how the fight between Dyne and Pale Rider ended to see if either was «Death Gun». Sinon and Kirito then watched as Pale Rider was stunned by an unseen enemy, who turned out to be «Death Gun», hidden under a «Metamaterial Optical Camouflage». Sinon tried to shoot «Death Gun» at Kirito's urging, however when she shot him, her bullet passed right next to him, not harming him at all. She then came to the conclusion that «Death Gun» had known where she was and had kept checking on her location. As she was thinking whether to shoot «Death Gun» again, he shot «Pale Rider» with his pistol. Sinon then watched as «Pale Rider» jumped up after the Stun Bullet's effect wore off, and waited for his counterattack, which never happened, as «Pale Rider» was disconnected. Sinon then spoke about how «Death Gun» had cheated as he had forcefully disconnected «Pale Rider», but Kirito told her that he had not been forcefully disconnected, but in fact killed in real life. Sinon told Kirito to watch the bridge so that she could check Death Gun's name, as the third satellite scan was about to take place. However, when she looked at the map, the player did not appear on the scan, thus Kirito and Sinon guessed that he was hiding underwater. As Kirito began pursuing Death Gun, Sinon trailed the former and insisted on coming with him, sharing her disbelief that he would survive the battle, and thus would not fulfil his promise to her. When Kirito warned her of the danger involved, Sinon argued that the danger was present regardless of whether she was with him due to Death Gun's position being unknown, a fact that Kirito reluctantly agreed with. At that moment, the two were ambushed by Kakouton, thus Sinon was ordered to shoot the attacker while Kirito covered her. Sinon watched as Kirito parried Kakouton's bullets and found herself longing to understand his strength. After the opponent was defeated with one shot from her Hecate, Sinon and Kirito assumed that Death Gun would favor cover as a sniper, and thus he would head for the Lost City to the north. As they reached the outskirts of the abandoned city without seeing any sign of their target, Sinon reminded Kirito that they were still ignorant of Death Gun's actual character name. While they reviewed their remaining suspects, Sterben and Jūshi X, Sinon hypothesized the latter to be the most likely candidate, as the name Jūshi X had a kanji that was a homonym of the Japanese word for "death", while the X vaguely resembled a cross. With no other ideas, they decided to focus on Jūshi X if both suspects were in the city, with Sinon providing covering fire while Kirito drew their target's attention. When the satellite scan began one minute later, the two found only two users in the city: Jūshi X in a stadium and «Licolo» slightly to the west of it. This seemingly confirmed their suspicion, thus they headed closer to the stadium, where they managed to catch a glimpse of Jūshi X's sniper rifle. At that moment, Sinon was persuaded by Kirito's to provide supporting fire with her sniper rifle while he attacked Jūshi X from the rear. However, while Sinon was approaching her sniping position, she found herself collapsed on the road due to being hit by a stun bullet from her blind spot. As she bewilderedly attempted to determine what had occurred, she discovered that Death Gun, who was revealed to be Sterben, had been using an Metamaterial Optical Camouflage Mantle to conceal himself to ambush her. Realizing that Sterben had been using the mantle to snipe his quarries and avoid the satellite scan, Sinon could only listen as he drew closer to her and declared that he would kill her. Having recovered from her shock, Sinon struggled to move her right hand to her H&K MP7 submachine gun on her waist before Sterben could fire. However, just when she managed to draw her sidearm from her waist, the girl noticed to her horror that Sterben's handgun was a Type 54 "Black Star", the same gun she had used to kill the bank robber five years prior. Losing her grip on her submachine gun in shock, the sniper hallucinated the bank robber under Death Gun's cloak, which resulted in her resigning to death. To her surprise, however, Sterben was abruptly shot by another player, who also threw a smoke grenade in-between her and Sterben. Under the cover of the smoke, Sinon's petrified avatar and her equipment were retrieved by Kirito. After the duo commandeered the only serviceable buggy at a nearby rental point, Sinon was asked to destroy the only other vehicle at the rental point to prevent Death Gun from using it to overtake them. Much to her shock and distress, however, she found herself unable to even touch the trigger. As Sinon began suffering a panic attack upon seeing Sterben pursuing them, the two were forced to retreat without decommissioning the horse, which allowed Death Gun to continue pursuing them on horseback. With some encouragement and assistance, Sinon managed to fire a shot from her Hecate, which accidentally hit the fuel tank of a truck instead and triggered an explosion that destroyed the horse, allowing the duo to escape. Having driven some distance out of the city and into the desert, the pair eventually took shelter in a cave, where they would be hidden from the satellite scan and be able to detect if Sterben attempted to ambush them again. Although still shaken by the encounter, Sinon refused to remain behind when Kirito declared he would continue fighting Death Gun by himself before the mantled player could kill anyone else. While discussing why they both needed to stop Sterben despite his seeming power to kill people from within the game, the girl remembered how the mantled player had ignored Dyne after dispatching Pale Rider. Realizing Sterben was being selective with who he targeted, the two pondered any possible commonalities between his victims and Sinon. After Sinon recalled how she and XeXeeD had the opportunity to receive a physical model gun for their participation in the previous BoB due to registering their real-world addresses, the duo eventually determined Death Gun was actually comprised of at least two people. Having stolen their quarries' real-life residential information by spying on them in the regent's office, one member would shoot their target in-game while another infiltrated the target's home to inject them with a lethal drug at the same time. Though horrified at the thought that the real-world accomplice was already poised to kill her, Sinon was reassured they could still disrupt the killers' plan by defeating Sterben before he could shoot her. Having learned from the 21:45 Satellite Scan that they, Sterben, and Yamikaze were the only competitors remaining, Sinon relocated to a relatively secure sniping spot while Kirito moved into position to lure their opponents out of hiding. From her vantage point, the girl eventually spotted Yamikaze racing towards her partner's location. As the agile gunman was moving too quickly in an erratic course to reliably make an accurate shot, she waited until a bullet fired by Sterben missed Kirito and landed near Yamikaze. The unexpected gunshot forced the ninja-like player to slow down behind cover just enough for the sniper to shoot and kill him, eliminating any possibility of Yamikaze defeating Kirito or being targeted by Death Gun. Her primary objective complete, Sinon turned her attention to where Kirito was charging toward Sterben, pinpointing where the mantled player was ineffectively firing at the lightswordsman. Since they both had exposed their positions with their first shot, the girl saw a Bullet Line from Death Gun targeting her in response to her aiming at him. Thus, the snipers were forced to fire simultaneously, with the bullets respectively destroying the Hecate's scope and Sterben's Accuracy International L115A3's receiver. Unable to continue sniping at her current distance without the scope, Sinon watched as the mantled player moved to confront Kirito. To her shock, Sterben withdrew from the remains of his Silent Assassin a long, needle-thin blade, with which he countered the photon sword user's assault. Horrified to see Death Gun easily overpowering Kirito, the girl desperately considered any way she could intervene without putting herself or her partner at risk, until a sudden flash of inspiration came to her. With her Hecate, the sniper aimed a Bullet Line at Sterben, distracting the mantled swordsman just long enough for the photon sword user to recover and defeat him. Having scavenged a plasma grenade from Yamikaze's corpse after confirming Kirito's victory, Sinon rejoined her partner. Although Death Gun's defeat should have forced his confederate to abort their plan, they exchanged contact information so the boy could arrange for the police to be sent to the girl's apartment, just to be safe. Afterwards, as she felt it would be unsportsmanlike to duel the lightswordsman in his current suboptimal condition, the sniper chose to instead end the tournament in a tie. To that end, she handed the grenade to Kirito and activated it, then hugged him to prevent him from throwing it aside before it detonated, killing them both simultaneously and crowning them as the third Bullet of Bullets' co-champions. Once she had confirmed no one else was in her apartment after being logged out, Shino was about to refresh herself when she was unexpectedly visited by Kyouji, who had brought a cake as congratulations for her victory. Though surprised at the speed of his arrival so soon after the BoB's conclusion, the girl allowed the boy inside, as she had already been planning to contact him so he could stay by her side until the police arrived. While discussing the events of the tournament, however, Shino was surprised when her friend revealed he had seen seen her very close with Kirito in the desert cave. The girl attempted to clarify she had only been venting her anger on the lightswordsman during one of her panic attacks but was suddenly hugged and pushed onto her bed by Kyouji, who confessed his love for like a curse. Stunned by the boy's uncharacteristic action, she shoved him back but remained frozen as he withdrew and held to her neck a needleless syringe filled with, which he explained would relax her muscles and stop her heart. Remembering Kirito's theory that Sterben's victims may have been killed via lethal drug injection, Shino realized to her shock that Kyouji was one of Death Gun's accomplices. Her suspicion having been confirmed by her friend, her horror was further compounded when he revealed that the mantled player she had faced in BoB was his brother, Kirito's old enemy from Laughing Coffin in SAO, and that he intended to kill her and himself so they could be reborn in another world. Desperately hoping to stall for time, the girl attempted to dissuade Kyouji from his plan, explaining it would inconvenience Death Gun's reputation and reminding him of his real life aspirations. To her despair, she learned the boy was set on following through with his scheme, as well as how he had been inspired by her killing the bank robber, hence why the Black Star had been chosen as Sterben's handgun. Paralyzed with fear and hopelessness, Shino was about to accept her fate when she realized Kirigaya Kazuto (Kirito) would likely come to her apartment to personally check on her and thus put himself in danger, which she refused to let happen. Motivated by an mental image of Sinon encouraging her to fight for others, the girl managed to free herself from Kyouji, using her Procyon SL model gun to exploit the boy's delusions and keep him away while she attempted to reach the door. However, she tripped and lost her grip on the model gun, giving Kyouji enough of an opportunity to catch her by the leg right before Shino could open the door. At that moment, though, she was freed once more from his hold when another boy, who she recognized as Kazuto, burst into the apartment and attacked Kyouji. Just when Shino was about to obey Kazuto's injunction to get help, she remembered Kyouji was still in possession of the syringe of succinylcholine.
