While quenching his thirst at a stream moments later, Kirito heard a sound in the area and decided to investigate it. At the source of the sound, Kirito found a boy sitting next to a gigantic tree. Unsure whether the boy was a player or a Non-Player Character (NPC), Kirito introduced himself, carefully choosing the phrasing of his questions to obtain more information from the boy without alarming him, in case he was not aware of the outside world. As the boy did not understand his gaming terms, Kirito realised that it would be pointless to request information pertaining to the real world from the boy, thus he instead asked for a place to stay. The boy suggested going to the nearby village of Rulid, where the church could provide lodging for a visitor. He also offered to lead Kirito to the village himself, in order to help him explain his situation to the village's guards so they would be more willing to let him pass, after finishing his work at the tree. When Kirito accepted his offer, the boy recalled that he had yet to introduce himself, thus he shared that his name was Eugeo, before offering Kirito some bread. During a conversation about the bread, Eugeo mentioned that a girl named Alice used to bring him lunch at noon, before she was arrested. After sharing the story of what had happened to the girl with Kirito, Eugeo returned to his work. During the following break, the boy explained that his Sacred Task was to cut the gigantic Gigas Cedar tree, as it prevented the village from expanding due to exhausting the resources in the area; however, he was not expected to actually finish the job in his lifetime, as the tree was too durable. Wishing to repay the boy for his kindness, Kirito offered to help him with his job, though surprised when he learnt that the job was more difficult than he had expected. Several hours later, with the quota for the day fulfilled, the two boys stored Eugeo's axe at a nearby shed, before heading to the village. At the entrance to Rulid Village, the two boys were approached by Jink, the captain of the village's guards. As the guard began teasing Eugeo about his Sacred Task when the newcomer claimed he could not recall what his own was, Kirito suddenly asserted a belief that he used to be a swordsman. Sceptical about the claim, Jink offered the boy his sword to prove he could use it. To everyone's surprise, however, Kirito managed to unintentionally activate a Sword Skill during his demonstration, leaving Jink speechless as Eugeo stated he would lead Kirito into the village. After meeting various villagers along the way, the two boys eventually arrived to the church, where Eugeo summoned Sister Azalia to request for a place that Kirito could lodge. Sometime later, Azalia's assistant, Selka Zuberg, provided Kirito with a pillow and a blanket, and informed him of the rules at the church. After the girl left his room, Kirito contemplated on the world he found himself in, concluding that none of the villagers were Non-Player Characters. As Rath did not have enough Soul Translators to support all these inhabitants, while Eugeo claimed that many years had passed in this world, Kirito deduced that the people he met had to be Artificial Fluctlights, copies of newborn Fluctlights who were raised in the virtual world. Pondering on what Rath's goal was and how much time had been accelerated in this world, the boy speculated that he might find a method to contact the outside world in a bigger city and fell asleep as he deliberated the need of a partner for his journey.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 03 is the third episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on October 20, 2018. Plot. On the 20th Day of the 3rd Month, Kirito was aroused from sleep by Selka Zuberg early in the morning. After breakfast, Kirito joined Eugeo at the Gigas Cedar, mulling about the need to fell the tree to get the boy's help in order to reach the central city in the empire. During a lunch break, Kirito learnt about Selka being Alice Zuberg's sister and rumours about recent goblin sightings in the area. The conversation eventually led to the topic of Sacred Arts, which prompted Kirito's curiosity on the possibility of a more effective way to cut the tree. While Eugeo denied the existence of a better tool than the Dragon Bone Axe in the village, the boy recalled having an item that was more powerful than the axe. Some time later, Eugeo brought the Blue Rose Sword to Kirito. After explaining the legend behind the sword and that he had carried the sword from the Northern Cave to a storage shed near the tree in a span of three months two years prior in hopes of being able to use it one day, the boy offered Kirito to try swinging it. As such, Kirito decided to test the sword on the Gigas Cedar; while the self-proclaimed swordsman was able to cut into the tree and deal damage to it, the heaviness of the sword prevented him from hitting the existing cut on the tree, thus reducing the effectiveness of the slash. During Eugeo's turn chopping the tree with the axe, Kirito investigated the status of the sword, discovering that its class outranked his Object Control Authority. That evening, while mulling about the Artificial Fluctlights' aversion to breaking the rules, the Axiom Church that created the rules, and Alice, who managed to violate them, during a bath back at the church, Kirito heard Selka outside the bathroom and decided to request her to answer some of his questions. Minutes later, Kirito returned to his room, where Selka was waiting for him. When Kirito broached the topic of Alice, he learnt from the girl that Eugeo had stopped smiling ever since Alice was arrested, while the other villagers began overwhelming her with their great expectations of her as Alice's sister. Just as Kirito finished comforting the girl to just be herself, the church bells rang, prompting Selka to take her leave. Just before leaving the room, Selka enquired about the reason for Alice's arrest, learning about her sister's entering the Dark Territory. While washing his face the following morning, Kirito was approached by Sister Azalia, from whom he learnt that Selka had been missing the entire morning. After breakfast, Kirito hurried to meet with Eugeo to ask if he had seen her. During their conversation, Kirito recalled his conversation with Selka the previous evening and realised that she could have travelled to the Mountain Range at the Edge. Alarmed by this realisation, the two boys rushed to the Northern Cave to find her. While travelling through the cave, the two heard a scream ahead and hurried to investigate it. When they reached a large room inside the cave, the duo found that Selka had been abducted by a group of goblins. Upon noticing the girl, Eugeo shouted her name, unintentionally alerting the goblins to their presence. As the monsters approached the boys with the intent to kill them, Eugeo succumbed to terror.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 04 is the fourth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on October 27, 2018. Plot. Having encountered a group of goblins at the Mountain Range at the Edge in their search for Selka on the 21st Day of the 3rd Month, Eugeo had become frozen in terror. As the monsters continued approaching them, Kirito helped Eugeo suppress his dread, before sharing his plan with the boy. The two would charge at the nearest goblins and douse the goblins' fire to earn an opportunity to retrieve a weapon from their stockpile. Ordering Eugeo to occupy the smaller goblins while he himself dealt with their leader, Kirito began executing their plan, successfully retrieving a sword for himself and one for Eugeo. As his partner distracted some of the goblins, Kirito charged through the remaining ones to meet with their leader, Ugachi the Lizard Killer in battle. During their battle, Kirito eventually activated a three-hit Sword Skill named «Sharp Nail», severing one of Ugachi's arms in the process. However, prematurely celebrating his victory, Kirito momentarily lost his vigilance, allowing Ugachi to retaliate with a slash at the boy's own arm. Having collapsed and now suffering immense pain from the slash, Kirito somehow managed to rise to his feet and launch a second attack with a Sword Skill, before being kicked back to the ground by the goblin. Just as the boy was about to receive the finishing blow in his state of terror, Eugeo conquered his fear and rushed to his friend's aid, suffering a lethal injury during the clash. As blood spilled from his wounds, the boy recalled his suppressed childhood memories with Kirito, triggering the latter's own suppressed memories of his time with Eugeo and Alice during his first FullDive. As Eugeo lost consciousness, the anguish from Kirito's memories overshadowed his physical pain, filling him with renewed vigour. Using this newfound energy, Kirito assaulted Ugachi, eventually severing the goblin's head with another Sword Skill, named «Sonic Leap». Once the other goblins began fleeing at the sight of their leader's severed head, Kirito quickly untied Selka and brought her to Eugeo to help seal the boy's wounds. As regular Sacred Arts could no longer help with the wounds, Selka requested Kirito's help with a higher-level art. Using the art, the girl began transferring Kirito's and her own Durability to the boy, causing the wound to begin sealing. Just before losing consciousness due to losing a large amount of his Durability, Kirito was visited by a phantom of Alice, telling the boy that she would be waiting for him and Eugeo at the top of the Central Cathedral in Centoria. Several days later, the now recovered Eugeo returned to working at the Gigas Cedar with Kirito. When the latter's turn at cutting the tree came, the swordsman decided to use the Blue Rose Sword instead of the Dragon Bone Axe, as he had become able to wield the once-heavy sword properly due to increasing his Object Control Authority through the battle against the goblins. With a single strike of the sword with the «Horizontal» Sword Skill, Kirito was able to deal significant damage to the tree, shocking Eugeo in the process. Having also become able to wield the sword due to the goblin battle, the boy requested Kirito to teach him his swordsmanship to fulfil his long-held desire of rescuing Alice. The two boys spent the following days practicing with the sword, either against a fictional opponent or against the Gigas Cedar. Eventually, while practicing the use of Sword Skills, Eugeo finally felled the tree, resulting in a celebration in the village later that evening. During the celebration, Eugeo was given the right to choose his new Sacred Task by the village chief, Gasupht Zuberg. Having asserted his desire to become a swordsman and received permission to travel to Zakkaria to achieve his goal from the village chief, Eugeo approached Selka the following morning, vowing to safely return to the village with Alice. Some time later, Eugeo and Kirito departed from the village on their journey, hoping to ultimately reach Alice at the Central Cathedral.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 05 is the fifth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 3, 2018. Plot. On June 28, 2026, having encountered Kanamoto Atsushi, the last remaining member of Death Gun, equipped with a syringe of succinylcholine that he planned to use against them, while escorting Yuuki Asuna home, Kirigaya Kazuto pushed his girlfriend away to safety as he intercepted the man's attack with his umbrella. However, the boy was injected with the drug during the brawl, causing him to collapse due to cardiac arrest. Witnessing this event, Asuna momentarily recalled a similar scene during her time Sword Art Online two years prior, during which she had been protected by Kirito from a Laughing Coffin member's attack. Having accompanied her injured boyfriend to the Setagaya General Hospital for treatment following the attack, Asuna waited in front of the operating room for Kazuto's surgery to be complete, being joined by Kirigaya Midori and Kirigaya Suguha just as she sat down. When the procedure was completed the next morning, the doctor informed them that although the operation saved Kazuto's life, the boy might have sustained permanent brain damage due to the long period of cardiac arrest. As Midori was signing the paperwork to transfer Kazuto to a better facility for magnetic resonance imaging, Asuna and Suguha were approached by Kikuoka Seijirou, who wished to speak with Kazuto's parents. That evening, Asuna and Suguha arrived at the National Defense Medical College Hospital, the institution where Kazuto was supposed to be currently hospitalised under Seijirou's advice; however, they were not allowed to see the boy. The following day, Asuna and Leafa met Lisbeth, Silica, Sinon in ALfheim Online (ALO), where the two informed the girls that the hospital refused to allow their visit due to Kazuto being treated with specialized equipment at the time. However, feeling suspicious about the claim, the two investigated the matter further and thus discovered that Kazuto's ambulance had never arrived at its destination, despite the boy being admitted to the hospital according to the records. As Seijirou had disappeared that same day and had access to a device that could connect to the user's soul itself, the girls speculated that Kazuto could have been transported to one of Rath's facilities with a Soul Translator. At that moment, Asuna informed the other girls that she had requested Yui to analyse the data of an application connected to sensors implanted in Kazuto's chest as part of his job, in hopes of finding something that could lead them to his current location. Prompted by Asuna, the Navigation Pixie reported that Kazuto's last known position was in Minato Ward, at around 21:20 the day before. Later that same day, Asuna and Suguha requested Tsuboi Ryoutarou (Klein) to drive them to Kazuto's last known position at the Shinagawa Wharf in Minato Ward, hoping to find more clues as to Kazuto's whereabouts. Following Rika's (Lisbeth's) report from Roppongi that the cameras around Rath's office there had not seen Kazuto, Yui reported that a helicopter had departed from Shinagawa Wharf the moment when Kazuto's signal was lost, much to Asuna's sorrow. Encouraged not to lose hope by Yui, Asuna continued to search for other hints to Kazuto's whereabouts by asking Suguha if she recalled hearing anything about Rath from her cousin. This led to Asuna learning that the Soul Translator was based on the Medicuboid, a FullDive device for medical purposes created by Kayaba Akihiko and his acquaintance, Koujiro Rinko. The latter, according to Yui's investigation, was a researcher at a university in California, as well as a member of the laboratory that Kayaba Akihiko had worked at, prompting Asuna to speculate that she might have knowledge about the Soul Translator and Rath. The following evening in California, while checking her mailbox, filled with invitations from Kikuoka Seijirou to participate in his project, Rinko reminisced about her days with her lover, Kayaba Akihiko. The man had once shared his lifelong dream: a large castle, consisting of multiple floors with a palace at the very top. Moments after finishing her reminiscence, Rinko was alerted to a new e-mail having arrived to her mailbox. To her surprise, however, e-mail was sent by a person named Yuuki Asuna, rather than being another message from Kikuoka Seijirou. Several days later, Koujiro Rinko and her assistant Megumi Reynolds were flown to the Ocean Turtle, Rath's secret base in the ocean. Upon landing, the two were greeted by Lieutenant Nakanishi, who escorted them to a control room-like area after numerous security procedures. There, the women met Kikuoka Seijirou and Higa Takeru, Rinko's former colleague from the Shigemura Lab. Stating that the project now had all three individuals he believed to be indispensable for it, two of whom were Rinko and Takeru, Seijirou shared his hope to be able to introduce them to the third person in a few days, as he was currently unavailable. At that very moment, Megumi Reynolds discarded her disguise, revealing her true identity as Yuuki Asuna. Due to Seijirou's astonishment, Rinko explained that the young girl had informed her about the Soul Translator and Kazuto's disappearance in order to request her help in reuniting with the boy. Once the two women explained how they had bypassed Rath's security to allow Asuna to infiltrate the base, the girl demanded the whereabouts of her beloved with a serious expression.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 06 is the sixth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 10, 2018. Plot. Having arrived at the Ocean Turtle and discarded her disguise, Yuuki Asuna demanded the information about Kirigaya Kazuto (Kirito) from Kikuoka Seijirou. Thus, the man explained that Kazuto had sustained serious brain damage in the attack by Kanamoto Atsushi (Johnny Black), which could only be treated by using Rath's Soul Translator (STL) to directly stimulate the boy's Fluctlight, in order to induce the generation of a new neural network in his brain. Once Asuna was satisfied with the explanation, Koujiro Rinko requested to learn the details of Seijirou's secret project and how Kazuto was relevant to it, as they were already considerably involved. Interested in receiving Rinko's assistance on his project, Seijirou revealed that its true purpose was to create Bottom-Up Artificial Intelligence (Bottom-Up AI), a type of AI that would be able to respond appropriately to any unexpected situation without prior training, unlike the usual Top-Down AI. Such an adaptive artificial intelligence was created by using the Soul Translator to scan and replicate the Fluctlight of a human; however, Rath soon realised that a significant chasm existed between a replicated Fluctlight and a true artificial intelligence. To illustrate this point, Seijirou ordered Higa Takeru to load a copy of his own Fluctlight, demonstrating how it became unstable and collapsed upon learning that it was not the original Takeru. In order to overcome this obstacle, Seijirou and Takeru had scanned the Fluctlights of newborn infants, creating a Soul Archetype of a human Fluctlight without any memories by eliminating any differences between the scanned infant Fluctlights. The archetype was then replicated, creating sixteen different AI individuals, whom Rath then placed into a virtual world created with The Seed to raise them. Once four of Rath's employees raised the initial Artificial Fluctlights to the age of eighteen, the Artificial Fluctlights began to have children of their own. Using the Fluctlight Acceleration function of the Soul Translator, Rath accelerated the time in the virtual world, allowing the Fluctlights to create a middle age-like society with a population of approximately 80,000 citizens in the span of three weeks in the real world. At this point, Rath noticed a fundamental issue that hindered their plans: the Artificial Fluctlights' absolute obedience to their self-established law, known as the Taboo Index, which prevented them from committing murder. Hearing this, Asuna realized that Rath's true objective was to create artificial intelligence capable of murder, a goal that Kazuto would never have supported due to his belief in the rights of artificial intelligence. Just as Seijirou argued that the life of one solider was more important to him than the life of thousands of AIs, Rinko reminded him of the need to clarify Kazuto's role in the project. Thus, Seijirou revealed that Kazuto, as a person with years of experience of living in a virtual world, was recruited for their project in an effort to test whether a real human, brought to the world as a child with no memories of their real life, would also be unable to violate the law. At the end of the conversation, Asuna logged into ALfheim Online (ALO) to update Leafa, Lisbeth, Silica, and Sinon on what she had learnt on the Ocean Turtle. Asuna informed her friends that Kazuto had befriended two artificial Fluctlights, a boy and a girl, during his time in Underworld. The girl, named Alice, had broken a clause of the Taboo Index due to prioritising the life of another Fluctlight. Although such an action was precisely what Rath was seeking, by the time Takeru and Seijirou noticed the event, Alice had already been apprehended by the Axiom Church and had her Fluctlight adjusted to prevent such conduct. After recounting Alice's story, Asuna bid farewell to her friends, as it was almost time for her to visit Kazuto. Minutes later in the Ocean Turtle's upper shaft, Asuna was gazing at her boyfriend, lying in a bed connected to a Soul Translator, together with Rinko when the two were approached by Aki Natsuki, the nurse who had been providing care for Kazuto after the Sword Art Online incident, as well as during the Death Gun incident. The nurse revealed she had been working for the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) and was assigned by Kikuoka Seijirou to oversee Kazuto's medical condition. When the nurse confirmed that Kazuto's treatment was proceeding well, Rinko requested a private conversation with Asuna. In their quarters, Rinko revealed that Kayaba Akihiko had implanted a bomb in her left breast; however, this only served as a deception to ensure she would be free of any charges. Although Rinko initially planned to kill the man when she learnt of the Sword Art Online incident, she was unable to end the life of her beloved when she found his hideout, instead finding herself caring for Akihiko's during his dives into SAO. Seeing Rinko apologizing in tears about her inability to stop the incident, Asuna comforted the woman by sharing that neither she, nor Kazuto had ever blamed her for anything, especially since the death game had also allowed her to experience the happiest days in her life. Later that night, after having a strange dream of being visited by Akihiko, Rinko suddenly awoke and looked outside her room in confusion.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 07 is the seventh episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 17, 2018. Plot. After departing from Rulid Village, Eugeo and Kirito successfully enrolled into the Sword Mastery Academy in Centoria as part of their goal to become Integrity Knights, which would grant them the right to enter the Central Cathedral, where they could find Eugeo's childhood friend, Alice Zuberg. On the 1st Day of the 3rd Month, 380 HEC, nearly two years after the start of their journey, the two boys decided to use their rest day to visit the town. After buying some treats from the Prancing Deer Inn, the two boys encountered Kirito's mentor, Sortiliena Serlut, the Second Seat swordswoman at the academy. After a short chat, the two boys and Sortiliena parted ways to enjoy the remainder of their rest day. Nearly a week later, on the 7th Day of the 3rd Month, 380 HEC, Kirito and Sortiliena held a sparring match in the latter's dormitory. Following her victory in the match, Sortiliena praised the boy for his growth, revealing that she had selected him as her Valet due to a similarity in their sword styles. However, she was concerned about being unable to beat Volo Levantein, the First Seat swordsman at the academy, over the course of the past two years with her sword style due to a lack of confidence to withstand his blade. On the other hand, the swordswoman believed that the reason Kirito was unable to beat her was due to him concealing the true potential of his sword style. As his mentor wished to see his true skill, the boy promised to demonstrate it to her the following day as a graduation present. Some time later, Kirito returned to his own dormitory after a lengthy practice session with Sortiliena. After being confronted by Instructor Azurica about breaching the curfew, Kirito joined Eugeo at the cafeteria. During their meal, the two were verbally harassed by two noble students, Raios Antinous and Humbert Zizek. In order to help Kirito ignore the provocations, Eugeo asked his partner about the state of his personal garden, leading to the two boys visiting the flowers that Kirito was raising as a graduation gift for his mentor. Surprised by Kirito's newfound hobby, Eugeo speculated that Kirito might be regaining his memories, causing the boy to be concerned that Kirito would one day leave him if he did regain his memories. Reassured that this would not be the case, Eugeo offered to help his partner with his Sacred Arts the following day, prompting Kirito to remind Eugeo about his plans to claim his new sword that day. As the following day was a rest day, the two boys came to the shop of an artisan named Sadore. Under the advice of Garitta, Eugeo's predecessor, Kirito had retrieved a branch of the Gigas Cedar that had accumulated the most resources before leaving Rulid Village, in order to have it fashioned into a sword by the craftsman when the boys reached the capital. After a year of diligent work, Sadore succeeded in producing a an impressive black sword that he allowed Kirito to claim it as his own free of charge when the boy proved that he was able to wield it. Upon returning to the academy, Kirito found a discreet place to test his new sword to see if he would be able to use his more advanced Sword Skills with it. However, during an attempt to execute a five-hit skill, Kirito accidentally flung a piece of dirt onto Volo Levantein, the First Seat swordsman, who had come to the same spot to practice his own swordsmanship in secret. At that moment, the elite swordsman confronted Kirito about practicing with a sword on a rest day. While electing to ignore this specific offence as he himself enjoyed finding excuses to wield his sword even on rest days, Volo decided to use the fact that Kirito stained the elite swordsman's uniform as pretext to have a battle with him. As punishment for disrespect, Kirito was forced to accept a duel with real swords against Volo at the main training hall. News of their duel quickly spread, attracting a significant number of people, including Eugeo and Sortiliena, to the training hall. When Sortiliena requested to know the rules of their duel, Volo stated his desire for a match without the need to avoid physical contact. As this type of duel required mutual consent, the swordsman allowed Kirito to make the final choice. Despite warnings from his mentor, Kirito did not refuse Volo's request for a first point duel.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 08 is the eighth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 24, 2018. Plot. On the 8th Day of the 3rd Month, 380 HEC, having stained the uniform of the Sword Mastery Academy's First Seat swordsman Volo Levantein and thus forced into a sparring match against the swordsman as punishment, Kirito was about to begin his battle when his mentor, Sortiliena Serlut, approached him. Sortiliena warned the boy that Volo had a practice of engaging other swordsmen in one-point battles with real swords in order to strengthen his own abilities with the sword from the experience. Just before letting the boy return to his battle, Sortiliena asserted her belief in him and reminded him of his promise to display all that he is capable of to her, urging him to use his match against Volo as an opportunity to fulfil the promise. Seeing that Volo entered the stance for a Sword Skill for the two-handed sword named Avalanche and amplified the strength of the skill with his imagination, Kirito made the decision to counter the attack with a four-hit skill named Vertical Square, thus compensating for the fact that he was using a one-handed sword by employing a skill with a greater number of swings. With his third swing, Kirito managed to stop the descent of Volo's sword, resulting in the two locking their swords. Noticing that the burden of his lineage was the source of Volo's power, Kirito recalled the people important to him, causing his sword to absorb the resources in the area and grow in size and thus allowing him to break Volo's skill. Just as the two were about to initiate a second Sword Skill against each other, Azurica entered the hall and ordered the two swordsmen to halt their duel. In the aftermath of the duel, Sortiliena invited Kirito, as well as Eugeo and the latter's mentor Golgorosso Balto to celebrate in her room. Later that evening, with Eugeo and his mentor in an alcohol-induced slumber, Sortiliena and her valet continued their conversation at the table. While having a conversation about their sword styles, Sortiliena shared the story of how her family created the Serlut style as they were forbidden to use the High-Norkian style due to displeasing the emperor and thus. While Sortiliena was proud of her family's sword style, she still harboured a sense of inferiority when facing a representative of the High-Norkian style, which was the reason for her losses against Volo during her two years at the academy. However, witnessing Kirito's capabilities with his own irregular style helped Sortiliena understand her own issue better, thus the boy encouraged her to beat Volo in the final ranking examination match. Later that night, when Kirito left Eugeo sleeping in his bed for a breath of fresh air, the boy encountered Humbert Zizek and Raios Antinous as the two left the dormitory's garden. After ridiculing his fighting style during the battle against Volo, the two nobles left Kirito with a broken piece of one of his flowers as they departed from the scene. Filled with a bad premonition, the boy rushed into the garden, where he found that his personal planter had been utterly ravaged. The sight reminded Kirito of how he began growing the flowers as an experiment to see if he could use his imagination to allow the flowers to bloom despite the fact that the flower would not grow in the northern empire. Eventually, Kirito began to identify himself with the flowers as they struggled to bloom in foreign land, reminding him of how he himself felt lonely after being separated from the people important to him in the real world. As Kirito began weeping at the loss of the flowers, he heard a mysterious voice encouraging him to believe in the flowers, as well as his own strength. Alerting the boy to the fact that the other flowers desired to help, the voice explained that he did not need to know specific commands to guide the will of the flowers. With that encouragement, Kirito used his imagination to have the flowers share their life force with the broken flowers, thus helping them recover. Weeks later on the last day of the month, following Sortiliena's victory against Volo in the final ranking match, allowing her to graduate as the top swordsman of the year, Kirito gave a bouquet of his flowers to his mentor as a graduation gift. Meanwhile, Eugeo and Kirito became the new Sixth Seat and Fifth Seat after their advancement examination, thus being promoted to Elite Disciple status and gaining valets, named Tiese Shtolienen and Ronye Arabel respectively, of their own.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 09 is the ninth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 1, 2018. Plot. Eugeo and Kirito have advanced to the rank of elite students at the academy, where they are assigned to mentor two novice students, Ronye Arabel and Tiese Shtolienen. One day, they are challenged by Humbert Zizek, the second-best student in their class, to a sword fight. Eugeo accepts the challenge and manages to hold his own against Humbert, resulting in a tie. Later, during a picnic with their mentees, Eugeo and Kirito learn that Humbert has been mistreating his own novice student, Frenica Szeski, by forcing her to do humiliating tasks. They decide to confront Humbert and his friend, Raios Antinous, about their behavior, but they are met with indifference and arrogance. Humbert and Raios claim that they are following the rules of the academy and that Frenica has no choice but to obey them. Eugeo is outraged by their attitude, but he is unable to do anything about it. Tiese, who is close friends with Frenica, is also devastated by the situation and fears that she might end up marrying someone like Humbert in the future. Eugeo tries to console her and promises to protect her from any harm.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 10 is the tenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 8, 2018. Plot. Eugeo and Kirito realize that their pages are missing and Kirito leaves to look for them. Soon after, Frenica approaches Eugeo and informs him that the pages intend to confront Humbert for her sake, to stop his abuse of her. Eugeo storms Raios and Humbert's room, where he finds Ronye and Tiese gagged and tied up on a bed. Knowing that the taboo code prevents Eugeo from interfering, Raios and Humbert prepare to rape the girls in front of him, until Eugeo decides to violate the code and cuts off Humbert's arm. In the process of violating the code, Eugeo has to fight against the seal in his right eye, which causes his eye to be destroyed. Raios attempts to execute Eugeo but Kirito arrives and defends him. Kirito fights Raios, cutting off his arms, which leads to him glitching to death, while Humbert escapes. After the incident, an instructor restores Eugeo's eye. The next day both Kirito and Eugeo are handed over to an Integrity Knight and are surprised to discover the knight is none other than Alice.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 11 is the eleventh episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 15, 2018. Plot. Eugeo was convinced that the woman in shining armor was none other than Alice, his childhood friend who had been taken away by the Axiom Church. However, she did not show any sign of recognition towards him or Kirito, the swordsman from another world who had become his partner. Instead, she arrested them for violating the Taboo Index and brought them to a prison cell in the Central Cathedral. Kirito and Eugeo did not give up hope and used their high object control authority, a rare skill that allowed them to manipulate the properties of objects, to escape from their confinement. They decided to climb up the tower and confront the Administrator, the ruler of the Underworld, who was behind Alice's abduction and brainwashing. However, Alice had anticipated their move and dispatched another Integrity Knight, a powerful warrior loyal to the Axiom Church, to stop them. Meanwhile, in the real world, Asuna, Kirito's girlfriend and a skilled player of virtual reality games, was introduced to the first prototype of an AI robot that was being developed at the Ocean Turtle, a secret facility in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. She learned that the robot was connected to the Underworld, a simulation of a medieval society where Kirito had been trapped for more than a year

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 12 is the twelfth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 22, 2018. Plot. Eugeo and Kirito had escaped from the prison tower, but their freedom was short-lived. They soon encountered an Integrity Knight named Eldrie, who challenged them to a duel. Kirito accepted the challenge, while Eugeo watched from the sidelines. The battle was fierce, but Kirito had the upper hand. However, Eldrie revealed his trump card: a Divine Weapon that could manipulate ice and snow. He unleashed a barrage of frozen projectiles at Kirito, who barely dodged them. Eugeo felt a surge of recognition as he saw Eldrie's face and weapon. He realized that Eldrie was none other than his childhood friend, who had been taken away by the Integrity Knights years ago. He tried to call out to him, but Eldrie did not respond. Eugeo then remembered something that the Administrator had told him: that the Integrity Knights had their memories erased and replaced by false ones. Eugeo decided to test his theory. He shouted out loud some of the events that he and Eldrie had shared in their past, such as playing in the fields, fishing in the river, and making a promise to become Integrity Knights together. He also mentioned Eldrie's mother's name, which was Alice. Eldrie heard Eugeo's words, but they did not make sense to him. He felt a sharp pain in his head, as if something was trying to break free from his mind. He screamed in agony, clutching his forehead. A purple crystal emerged from his skin, cracking and shattering. It was a memory fragment that had been implanted by the Administrator. Eldrie's eyes widened as he saw Eugeo's face clearly for the first time. He recognized him as his long-lost friend. He felt a wave of emotions wash over him: joy, sadness, anger, confusion. He started to cry, unable to speak. Before Eugeo could reach out to him, another Integrity Knight appeared on the scene. He was Fanatio, the second-in-command of the Integrity Knights. He saw Eldrie's condition and realized that he had been corrupted by Eugeo's words. He attacked Eugeo with his Divine Weapon, a sword that could emit light beams. Kirito intervened and blocked Fanatio's attack with his own sword. He told Eugeo to run with Eldrie, while he held off Fanatio. Eugeo hesitated, but Kirito urged him to go. Eugeo grabbed Eldrie's hand and ran towards the opposite direction. They reached a dead end, where a large wall blocked their way. They had no way out. Fanatio was closing in on them, ready to strike them down. Suddenly, a warp gate opened on the wall. A voice told them to enter quickly, before it closed again. Eugeo recognized the voice as the same one that had helped them escape from the prison tower. He trusted the voice and dragged Eldrie into the warp gate. They found themselves in a grand library, filled with books and scrolls. The warp gate closed behind them, leaving them alone in the vast room. The voice spoke again, this time from a speaker on the wall. It introduced itself as Cardinal, the system that governed the virtual world they were in. It also revealed that it knew Kirito's true identity: a human from the real world who had been trapped in this world by an accident. Cardinal then proceeded to explain the history of this world: how it was created by a genius scientist named Kayaba Akihiko; how it was corrupted by an entity called Quinella; how Quinella became the Administrator and created the Taboo Index; how Cardinal opposed Quinella and tried to restore order; and how Kirito and Eugeo were involved in Cardinal's plan to defeat Quinella.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 13 is the thirteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on January 5, 2019. Plot. The story flashes back to a time when the Administrator was losing her memory space due to the accumulation of data. She decided to use a child as a memory storage device by linking their fluctlights. However, this was a grave error on her part, as it gave the child the same level of authority and power as the Administrator. The child, who later became the Cardinal of the Great Library, realized this and tried to overthrow the Administrator but failed. Cardinal escaped to one of the two places where The Administrator's authority did not reach: the Great Library. There, she spent two centuries plotting to defeat the Administrator and restore order to the Underworld. Along the way, she encountered Kirito and Eugeo, who were on a quest to rescue Alice. She also revealed to them how to recover the memories of the Integrity Knights, who were brainwashed by the Administrator. Thus, the Cardinal formed an alliance with Kirito and Eugeo to challenge the Administrator and reclaim Alice.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 14 is the fourteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on January 12, 2019. Plot. Kirito and Eugeo return to the Cathedral and reclaim their swords, but they are soon confronted by Deusolbert, an Integrity Knight. With Kirito's assistance, Eugeo defeats the knight and realizes that he is the same one who abducted Alice eight years ago. They also learn that the administrator erased his memories before that day. Deusolbert warns them that several Integrity Knights are waiting for them on the 50th floor of the Cathedral, with orders to eliminate them. Kirito and Eugeo continue their ascent, planning how to deal with the knights, when they encounter two young girls on their way.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 15 is the fifteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on January 19, 2019. Plot. Linel and Fizel claim to be novices who study at the cathedral, but they are actually Integrity Knights in disguise. They sneak up on Kirito and Eugeo and stab them with daggers coated with a paralyzing poison, hoping to earn the recognition of their fellow Knights. They drag the paralyzed Kirito and Eugeo to the 50th floor, where Fanatio, the second-in-command of the Integrity Knights, is waiting for them. However, Kirito had anticipated their treachery and had taken precautions to protect himself. He uses the same daggers to bind Linel and Fizel, and challenges Fanatio to a duel while Eugeo recovers. Eugeo then joins the fight and unleashes his "Perfect Weapon Control Arts" to subdue the knights.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 16 is the sixteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on January 26, 2019. Plot. Eugeo and Kirito manage to overcome Fanatio's fierce resistance and inflict a mortal wound on her. Kirito decides to use one of the sacred daggers given by Cardinal to heal her, despite the fact that they were meant for Alice and the Administrator. Fanatio is then taken away by Cardinal, while Eugeo and Kirito proceed to the 80th floor, where Alice is guarding the entrance to the Administrator's chamber. Kirito engages Alice in combat, hoping to create an opening for Eugeo to use the dagger on her, but their fight causes a breach in the outer wall and both of them are dragged outside by the wind pressure, leaving Eugeo alone and distraught.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 17 is the seventeenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on February 2, 2019. Plot. As they hung from the wall of the Central Cathedral, Kirito and Alice realized that they had no choice but to cooperate in order to reach the 95th floor, where they could re-enter the building. Kirito tried to explain to Alice that she had been manipulated by Administrator, and that her real memories were sealed away. Alice was skeptical, but listened to him anyway. They climbed up the wall, avoiding the traps and obstacles along the way. However, when they reached the higher floors, they were attacked by creatures from the Dark Territory, who had disguised themselves as statues. Kirito and Alice fought back with their swords, using their skills and teamwork to overcome the enemies. At the same time, Eugeo continued his ascent through the Cathedral, hoping to find Alice and rescue her. He arrived at a large bath on the 90th floor, where he was confronted by Bercouli Synthesis One, the leader of the Integrity Knights.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 18 is the eighteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on February 9, 2019. Plot. Eugeo faced Bercouli Synthesis One, the leader of the Integrity Knights, and unleashed the full power of his Blue Rose Sword. A massive wave of ice engulfed them both, freezing them in place. Eugeo activated the sword's secondary effect, which slowly sapped the life force of everything within the ice. He gambled that he had more vitality than Bercouli, and tried to persuade him to break free from Administrator's control. He reminded him of the Blue Rose Sword, hoping to trigger his lost memories. But to his shock, he learned that it was Bercouli who had killed the dragon that guarded the sword in the cave. Before he could say anything else, Prime Senator Chudelkin appeared out of nowhere. He used his authority to turn Bercouli into stone and capture Eugeo. He then dragged him away to face Administrator's wrath. Kirito and Alice were still climbing the wall that separated the human realm from the dark territory. They decided to take a break and rest for a while. Kirito seized the opportunity to tell Alice the truth about her past. He told her how she was once his childhood friend, how she had broken the Taboo Index, and how she had been taken away by an Integrity Knight. He explained that her memories had been altered by Administrator, and that she was not really an Integrity Knight. He asked her to trust him and join him in fighting against Administrator. Alice was skeptical and confused, but she listened to his story with curiosity and interest.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 18.5 is the recap episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation, set between the eighteen and nineteen episodes. It summarises the story from all previous episodes of the Alicization arc. It aired on February 16, 2019. Plot. While waiting on the outside wall of the Central Cathedral for Solus to raise, Kirito promised Alice to reveal all the past he knew about her, up to the current moment. Hearing that, the Integrity Knight agreed to listen to the boy's story; however, she added she would kill him if his words proved to be a lie.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 19 is the nineteenth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on February 23, 2019. Plot. Alice listens attentively as Kirito reveals the secrets of the Underworld, the origin of the Integrity Knights, and the true nature of Administrator. She feels a surge of doubt and anger towards the Axiom Church, and decides to renounce its authority over her life. However, as she tries to voice her defiance, she feels a sharp pain in her right eye. She realizes that it is the seal that prevents her from disobeying the church's rules. She grits her teeth and pushes through the pain, shouting out her rejection of the church, until her right eye bursts and she falls unconscious. On the other hand, Eugeo regains consciousness on the 100th floor. He sees Administrator lying on a bed and prepares to attack her, but she wakes up and casts a spell on him. She makes him lower his guard and forget his mission, and manipulates him into exposing his Fluctlight's core to her.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 20 is the twentieth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on March 2, 2019. Plot. Alice's eyes fluttered open as she felt a jolt of movement. She realized with a shock that she was being carried by Kirito, who had climbed up to the 95th floor of the Central Cathedral. She wondered where Eugeo was, and if he was safe. Kirito noticed her awakening and explained that he had used a sacred art to track Eugeo's sword, which was on the 90th floor, in a hall filled with ice and snow. But there was no sign of Eugeo himself. Alice felt a surge of worry and fear for her childhood friend. They reached the 95th floor, where Alice saw a familiar figure lying on a bed. It was Bercouli, the Integrity Knight Commander, who had fought with them against the Administrator. He looked like he was made of stone, his skin gray and his eyes dull. Alice gasped and ran to his side, tears streaming down her face. She called his name, hoping for a response. To her surprise, Bercouli opened his eyes slightly and smiled at her. He told her that he was proud of her for breaking the seal of the right eye, and that she should follow Kirito to the top floor, where the Administrator was hiding. He said that he had faith in them, and that they could end her tyranny. He closed his eyes again, and Alice felt his hand go limp. Alice and Kirito continued their ascent, reaching the 99th floor. There, they found a door that led to a room marked as "Senators' Chamber". Curious, they opened it and entered. What they saw inside made them sick to their stomachs. There were dozens of pods lining the walls, each containing a human body. They were hooked up to tubes and wires, their faces expressionless and their eyes empty. They looked like they were alive, but not living. Alice recognized some of them as former Integrity Knights, who had been stripped of their memories and wills by the Administrator. She realized that this was how the Administrator controlled the Senate, the highest authority of the church. She used these people as puppets, manipulating them with her voice and commands. Alice and Kirito were filled with anger and disgust at the Administrator's cruelty. They decided to leave the room and find her, but as they turned around, they saw a man blocking their way. He was wearing a red robe and a golden mask, and he introduced himself as Chudelkin, the Prime Senator. He said that he was loyal to the Administrator, and that he would not let them pass. He taunted them with his high-pitched voice and his twisted smile. He said that he had a surprise for them, and that they would soon meet their old friend again. He snapped his fingers, and a hole opened in the ceiling above them. From it, a figure descended slowly, holding a sword in his hand. It was Eugeo, but not as they knew him. His hair was white, his eyes were red, and his face was cold. He wore a black uniform with a silver cross on his chest. He spoke in a monotone voice, saying that he was Eugeo Synthesis 32, an Integrity Knight of the Administrator. He said that he had come to kill them.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 21 is the twenty-first episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on March 9, 2019. Plot. The scene is tense as Kirito and Eugeo clash swords, while Alice watches with a cold gaze. Kirito tries to break through Eugeo's brainwashing and remind him of their friendship, but Eugeo seems to be under the complete control of the piety module. However, as the battle progresses, Eugeo starts to show signs of hesitation and confusion, as his original memories resurface. He had not undergone a proper synthesis ritual, and his bond with Kirito was too strong to erase. He finally regains his free will and uses the Blue Rose Sword to freeze both Alice and Kirito in ice. He then proceeds to ascend the tower, determined to confront Administrator and end her tyranny. He pretends to be loyal to her and lets her remove the piety module from his eye, but he is secretly planning to stab her with his sword. However, his attack is blocked by a barrier that protects Administrator's body from any metal weapon. She is surprised by his betrayal and tries to resynthesize him, but fails. Eugeo resists her manipulation and prepares for a final showdown. Meanwhile, Kirito and Alice manage to break free from the ice and follow Eugeo's trail. They encounter Chudelkin, Administrator's loyal servant, who unleashes a powerful fire spell that summons a giant genie made of flames. The genie resembles Chudelkin and attacks Kirito and Alice with fiery blasts. The two have to fight their way through the inferno to reach Administrator's room and join Eugeo in the battle.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 22 is the twenty-second episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on March 16, 2019. Plot. Kirito, Alice, and Eugeo were struggling to fend off the Genie's attacks, until Kirito decided to target Chudelkin directly. He unleashed a powerful burst of incarnate arts, which altered his appearance to resemble his old outfit from Aincrad. This revealed to Administrator that Kirito was not a native of Underworld, but an intruder from the outside world. She engaged him in a brief conversation, before summoning a monstrous creature composed of swords, which she named Sword Golem. Kirito, Alice, and Eugeo had no chance against the beast, until a giant spider intervened and restrained the Golem. The spider was none other than Charlotte, the observation unit sent by Cardinal. She sacrificed herself to buy time for Eugeo, who followed Cardinal's instructions and stabbed a dagger into a hole in the floor. A portal opened and Cardinal emerged from it. She disabled the Golem with a lightning strike, healed Kirito and Alice's wounds, and lamented Charlotte's demise.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 23 is the twenty-third episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on March 23, 2019. Plot. Administrator, the ruler of the Axiom Church, cuts off the connection between the Underworld and the real world, and traps Cardinal, Kirito, Alice, and Eugeo in a dark space on the 100th floor. She reveals that the giant Golem she controls is made of divine swords that were once human beings from the Human Empire, and that its core is the Piety module, a device that controls the loyalty of the Integrity Knights. She plans to use half of the human population to create more Golems and fight against the Dark Territory. Cardinal offers to sacrifice herself in exchange for the release of Kirito, Alice, and Eugeo. Administrator agrees and unleashes a barrage of lightning bolts on Cardinal. Before dying, Cardinal fulfills Eugeo's wish to become one with his sword. Eugeo transforms into a sword and destroys the Golem's Piety module, then attacks Administrator and severs her arm. However, Administrator manages to break Eugeo's sword in two.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 24 is the twenty-fourth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on March 30, 2019. Plot. The final battle between Kirito and Administrator is a desperate one, as Kirito has to face the supreme ruler of the Underworld who knows every detail of the system. Administrator surprises Kirito by using Sword Skills from SAO, the game that trapped him for two years. Kirito is wounded and loses his right arm, but he is not alone. Eugeo, who has been cut in half but still alive, encourages Kirito to keep fighting and uses his blood and life force to restore the Blue Rose Sword, a crystal weapon that can freeze anything. Kirito takes the sword and dual-wields it with his own, delivering a devastating blow to Administrator's remaining arm. Administrator realizes that she cannot win and tries to escape the Underworld by accessing the system console. However, Chudelkin, her loyal servant who was burned by her fire magic, wakes up and clings to her, begging her not to leave him. The fire elements that were still active ignite them both, and they die in a blaze of flames. Eugeo's life is fading away, and he bids farewell to Kirito with the memory of young Alice in his mind. Kirito goes to the system console and manages to contact the real world, where he learns that the Ocean Turtle, the facility where his body is located, is under attack. Kikuoka tells Kirito to take Alice to the World's End Altar in the Dark Territory, a place where they can cross to the real world, before the communication is cut off. Kirito then collapses from the damage to his Fluctlight, as the power is shut down at Rath, causing a surge that affects his comatose body.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 25 is the twenty-fifth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on October 12, 2019. Plot. The aftermath of Administrator's defeat has left Kirito in a comatose state due to a fluctlight malfunction caused by the Ocean Turtle's power surge. Alice, who cares deeply for Kirito, decides to take him away from the Central Cathedral and return to her hometown of Rulid Village on the back of her loyal dragon Amayori. There, she builds a wooden cabin outside the village boundaries, where she lives with Kirito and tends to his needs every day. Alice is still considered an outlaw by the villagers, who shun her and forbid her from entering the village. However, she receives occasional visits from her sister Selka, who supports her, and she earns some money by chopping wood for Barbossa, a greedy and arrogant landowner who despises Alice. In the meantime, the Integrity Knights discover that Administrator had planned to turn half of the human population into mindless sword golems to fight against the Dark Territory's invasion. Alice is confronted by Eldrie Synthesis 31, who proposes to kill Kirito so that Alice can rejoin the Integrity Knights and help them defend the human realm. Alice rejects his offer, forcing Eldrie to leave. That night, Kirito has a sudden reaction and shows signs of distress. Alice realizes that something is wrong in Rulid, and she sees a bright orange light and smoke rising from the village.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 26 is the twenty-sixth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on October 19, 2019. Plot. Rulid is under siege by a horde of goblins and orcs. Alice dons her armor in secret and flies to the village on Amayori. She sees a few villagers fighting the goblins while the rest are ready to defend themselves. Alice tries to get them to safety, but they won't disobey the guards. Alice has no choice but to reveal herself as an Integrity Knight and command the villagers to leave, angering Barbossa. She regains her eye by sheer will and defeats the invaders. In the real world, Gabriel Miller and his team are on a submarine heading to Rath. They have taken over the main control room of Ocean Turtle but can't access it. Asuna, Kikuoka, and the others at Rath find out what's going on and plan to take back Ocean Turtle and protect A.L.I.C.E.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 27 is the twenty-seventh episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on October 26, 2019. Plot. Gabriel Miller, the CTO of GlowGen Defense Systems, is on a mission to capture Alice, the artificial fluctlight that holds the key to the Soul Translator technology. He and his team have infiltrated the Ocean Turtle, the secret base where the STL and the lightcube cluster are located, but they encounter a problem: the computer system is secured by a strong encryption and they cannot access the sub control room or the lightcube cluster without triggering an alarm. Gabriel remembers his previous encounter with Kirito, the hero of SAO, in GGO 4, where he fought him as Subtilizer, a mysterious player who can steal souls. He decides to use his STL to dive into the Underworld, the virtual world where Kirito and Alice are trapped, and take Alice by force. He logs in as Vector, the Dark Emperor who commands the dark forces, and brings his subordinate Vassago with him as a dark knight. Their plan is to exploit the final load test, a scenario that will erase the border between the Human Empire and the Dark Territory and unleash a war between them. Meanwhile, Asuna, Kirito's girlfriend and another SAO survivor, learns about the situation and decides to join Kirito in the Underworld to protect him and Alice. She logs in as Stacia, the Goddess of Creation who can manipulate the terrain. Back in Tokyo, Sinon, another GGO player and friend of Kirito and Asuna, wakes up from a nightmare where she relives her defeat by Subtilizer in GGO 4. She recalls his chilling words: "Your soul will be so sweet" and his brutal attack that choked her to death.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 28 is the twenty-eighth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 2, 2019. Plot. As he descended into the dark realm, Gabriel Miller recalled his childhood fascination with the essence of life. He had logged in with the supreme account of the Dark Emperor Vector, and he swiftly asserted his authority over the forces of the Dark Territory. General Shasta, who opposed the Emperor's schemes, shared his secret plan to assassinate him with his trusted companion and lover, Lipia. Vector contacted his real-world allies and retired to his chamber, where Lipia awaited him. Pretending to be a courtesan, she stabbed him with a concealed blade, but Vector overpowered her and strangled her to death, witnessing her radiant soul depart from her body. He flashes back to his childhood obsession with souls and his fixation on his friend named Alicia. Convinced her soul must be hidden deep beneath her brain matter, he jammed a long needle into her ear. As she died, he saw a glittering glow leave her body and ascend into the sky. In the Underworld, Vector addresses his legion of soldiers and presents Lipia's head frozen in ice as a warning to any who would challenge him. Shocked at the death of his lover, Shasta tries to kill Vector and unleashes a storm of incarnation, nearly wiping out the leaders of each respective army. As he aims for Vector, he is sucked into a void in his soul and disappears, leaving Vector unfazed. Meanwhile, in the human empire, Alice and Kirito arrive in the eastern camp near the Eastern Gate. Alice discovers that the gate is going to fall in a matter of days, removing the barrier between the Dark Territory and the Human Empire.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 29 is the twenty-ninth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 9, 2019. Plot. Alice and Kirito reached the military camp outside the eastern corridor, where they were greeted by the other Integrity Knights. Alice was concerned about Kirito's safety, as he was still in a coma after his battle with Administrator. She hoped that he would wake up soon and join them in the fight against the Dark Territory. Alice and the other knights discussed their strategy to defend the gate, which was under constant attack by the enemy forces. They knew that they had to hold out until reinforcements arrived from the Central Cathedral. Meanwhile, Ronie and Tiese arrived at the camp, carrying a message from Cardinal. They were shocked to learn about Eugeo's death and Kirito's condition, and they volunteered to take care of him. They prayed for his recovery and for the victory of the Human Empire. As the gate was about to collapse, everyone prepared for battle, ready to face their destiny.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 30 is the thirtieth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 16, 2019. Plot. The Human Empire army faces a fierce onslaught from the Dark Territory army, who use various strategies to break through their defenses. The front line is held by Deuselbert Synthesis 7, Fanatio Synthesis 2 and Eldrie Synthesis 31, who fight valiantly against the invaders. Behind them, Bercouli Synthesis 1 waits for the right moment to unleash his Time-Splitting Sword, while Sheyta Synthesis 12 and the fearful Renly Synthesis 27 support him. The battle claims many lives on both sides, including one of the Four Whirling Blades. Alice, concealed in the shadows, takes advantage of this and gathers the sacred power released from the dead bodies to create a powerful sacred art laser bomb. However, Renly loses his nerve and flees, leaving a gap in the rear line.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 31 is the thirty-first episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 23, 2019. Plot. The conflict rages on, and Alice utilizes the spatial elements from the fallen bodies to construct a powerful laser device. Renly, meanwhile, is hiding in a tent full of supplies, where he is discovered by Ronie and Tiese. They soon realize that the Mountain Goblins have breached the front lines and are raiding the supplies. Linel and Fizel swiftly eliminate the intruding goblins, and Renly musters his courage to join the battle with his Double-Winged Blade's flawless weapon control. Dee Eye Ill, the leader of the dark mages, commands all her minions to launch an aerial assault, but they are all obliterated by Bercouli's Time-Splitting Sword in one strike. The dark mages then attempt to cast a sacred art to target the rear lines, but their magic fails. Alice then detonates the device she was building and annihilates a large portion of Dark Territory soldiers, turning the tide in favor of the human empire forces.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 32 is the thirty-second episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on November 30, 2019. Plot. Alice had barely escaped the blast of the laser bomb that she had unleashed on the ogre horde. She looked around and saw the charred corpses of the enemy soldiers, but also noticed a large figure moving among them. It was Furgr, the ogre chief, who had somehow survived the explosion. He roared in rage and charged at Alice, swinging his massive club. Alice dodged his attack and countered with a slash of her sword, cutting through his armor and flesh. Furgr stumbled and fell to the ground, blood gushing from his wound. Alice finished him off with a stab to his heart. She felt no pity for him, only relief that he was dead. Meanwhile, Vector, the dark god who had invaded the Underworld, had sensed Alice's presence and power. He decided to capture her and use her as a key to access the real world. He ordered his army of dark knights, goblins, giants, and other creatures to march towards the human empire and seize Alice. However, the human army had anticipated his move and devised a plan to distract him. They formed a decoy force, led by Renly, Bercouli, Alice, Sheyta, Kirito, Ronie, Tiese, and four dragons. They also recruited a thousand volunteer soldiers and two hundred priests to join them. Their mission was to lure the dark army away from the corridor that connected the human empire and the dark territory, where the rest of the human army was waiting to defend it. They hoped that by doing so, they could buy enough time for Kirito to wake up from his coma and defeat Vector once and for all. The human empire was in grave danger. The dark mages had discovered the reason for their previous failure and devised a new plan. They sacrificed countless orcs to create more space elements and used them to unleash a horrific spell. A horde of venomous insects flew towards the human army, ready to devour them alive. The humans had no defense against such an attack. Eldrie, a young knight, made a noble decision. He used his own body as a shield and absorbed the insects' poison, saving his comrades from certain death. His sacrifice enraged Alice, the strongest knight of the human empire. She swore to avenge him and charged towards the dark mages. She wielded her sword with incredible skill and power, cutting down every enemy in her path. She single-handedly destroyed the entire mage unit and avenged Eldrie's death.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 33 is the thirty-third episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 7, 2019. Plot. As the diversionary unit advanced through the enemy lands toward the final stronghold, the Dark Emperor commanded the Fistfighters and the Dark Cavalry to chase them down. Sheyta Synthesis 12, also known as Sheyta the Silent, was afflicted with a curse that allowed her to slice through anything she touched, regardless of its hardness. Iskahn, the chief of the Fistfighter Guild, was confident that nothing could pierce his skin. When the Fistfighters caught up with the diversionary unit, Sheyta volunteered to stall them. She faced Iskahn in a fierce duel, where she managed to injure him with her razor-thin blade. After a prolonged deadlock, the two combatants developed a mutual admiration for each other and she retreated to rejoin the diversionary unit. At the end of the first day's journey, the diversionary unit set up a camp to rest. They were unaware that Vassago had been following them and secretly killing some of their men. When he targeted Ronie and Tiese as his next victims, the Goddess of Creation, Stacia, appeared from the sky and shielded them. However, before he fell into the abyss, Vassago recognized Asuna in the radiant light.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 34 is the thirty-fourth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 14, 2019. Plot. Asuna, who had used her Stacia power to create three huge fissures that swallowed up Vassago and his minions, as well as separated the Pugilists and the remaining Dark Knights from the decoy force, landed on the ground and introduced herself as Asuna to the awestruck force. She felt a pang in her head and realized that her fluctlight was overloaded by the massive terrain alteration. She knew that using her power too often could damage her fluctlight irreversibly. She exchanged greetings with the force and then headed to Kirito's tent. She was overjoyed to see him lying there. When Kirito heard Asuna's voice, he was visibly startled. Even in his vegetative state, he tried to reach out to her, with tears streaming down his face. Asuna embraced him with a hug that she had longed for. However, their reunion was interrupted by Alice, who barged in. They gathered to discuss the enemy's objective. Later that night, Ronie, Alice, Asuna, and Sortiliena told each other stories about Kirito.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 35 is the thirty-fifth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 21, 2019. Plot. The next day, the diversionary unit finds out that Vector has commanded his troops to cross the huge canyon by hanging from 10 ropes, and devises a way to stop them. At the same time, in the Ocean Turtle, Critter manages to deactivate the fluctlight acceleration and launches a patch program to lure AmuSphere users in America into a VRMMO game where they can kill other players, making them believe that it was a "beta test". Yui notices their scheme and alerts Kirito and Asuna's friends. Leafa and Sinon access the STL at Rath's Roppongi branch, and Lisbeth logs into ALO to persuade the Japanese players to join the Underworld against the American players. Critter deploys 20,000 American players on the opposite side of the huge canyon.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 36 is the thirty-sixth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on December 28, 2019. Plot. The Underworld is invaded by 20,000 foreign players who show no mercy to the Human Empire or the Dark Territory. Asuna, Alice, Bercouli, Renly, and Sheyta try to fight back against the overwhelming odds. Meanwhile, Gabriel Miller, the Dark Lord Vector, sees Alice and decides to capture her. He hijacks a dragon from a Dark Knight and flies in her direction. Iskahn, the leader of the Pugilists, is enraged by the massacre of his people, who are unable to defend themselves due to the system's restrictions. He breaks free from the Code 871 seal by tearing out his own right eye and crushing it. With a fierce resolve and a leap of faith, he crosses the ravine with the help of his loyal deputy. Iskahn, the leader of the Pugilists, agrees to ally with Asuna and the Human Empire Army in exchange for her promise to construct a bridge that would allow his people to cross the chasm. Meanwhile, Alice, eager to end the war quickly, flies ahead of the other Integrity Knights, only to be ambushed and captured by Emperor Vector, who mounts his dark dragon and heads for the World's End Altar. Bercouli, the oldest and strongest of the knights, follows them on his own dragon, determined to rescue Alice. The rest of the decoy force continues their advance, unaware that Critter has launched another wave of 20,000 American players to surround them. Vassago, who had previously fought Kirito and Asuna, decides to join the battle again using a "special" account that he had prepared. As the situation becomes desperate for the decoy force, a bright light descends from the sky. It is Sinon, who has logged in using the superaccount of Solus, the Sun Goddess. She unleashes her power and annihilates the American players.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 37 is the thirty-seventh episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on July 11, 2020. Plot. Sinon, who had taken the role of Solus the Sun Goddess, landed on the ground and hugged Asuna and Kirito, who was still unconscious. She told Asuna to leave Vector to her and focus on defending against the remaining American invaders. Elsewhere, Leafa entered the Underworld as Terraria the Earth Goddess and encountered Lilpilin, the leader of the Orcs. They quickly formed a bond and Leafa agreed to let Lilpilin take her to Dark Lord Vector as a captive. However, they were intercepted by Dee Eye Ell, a dark mage who had survived Alice's attack. She attacked Lilpilin and tried to drain Leafa's avatar's life force. Lilpilin overcame his system restriction and fought back to protect Leafa. Leafa freed herself and defeated Dee Eye Ell. In the south, Bercouli Synthesis One chased Vector on his dragon and used his secret skill, Uragiri, to bring down Vector's dragon. He engaged Vector in a fierce duel but was outmatched by Vector's superior abilities and stun powers. Knowing he had no chance of winning, Bercouli decided to sacrifice himself for Alice's sake. At the ruins, the American players were caught in a trap and Asuna joined the fight. Vassago returned to the game in a new avatar and watched Asuna from a distance. A bright light shone in the sky. It was Klein, who had come to help in his ALO avatar. More allies from outside the Underworld began to arrive.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 38 is the thirty-eighth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on July 18, 2020. Plot. Hundreds of ALO players, summoned by Yui, join Agil, Lisbeth and Silica to support Asuna in the battle against the Dark Territory. On the Ocean Turtle, Higa devises a method to revive Kirito's Fluctlight with the help of his friends, but he needs to reach the main control room where the invaders are. Bercoulli fights Vector and manages to kill him, but not before receiving a fatal wound. Alice finds Bercoulli's corpse and mourns for him. Bercoulli's soul lingers for a moment and tells Fanatio to take care of their child. Miller, unable to use his Vector avatar, asks Critter to transfer a character from his personal account so he can re-enter the Underworld and pursue his goals.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 39 is the thirty-ninth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on July 25, 2020. Plot. Alice is grief-stricken by Bercoulli's demise and hesitates to move on. Sinon urges her to continue towards the World's End Altar and promises to hold off Vector when he comes back from the real world. Elsewhere, Sheyta and Iskahn are engaged in a fierce battle against the enemy forces, until they are exhausted and outnumbered. They confess their love for each other before facing their doom. Asuna and the others are shocked to see Vassago reappear, using his PoH character and commanding a huge army of Korean and Chinese players. Miller returns to the Underworld as Subtilizer and confronts a terrified Sinon. On the Ocean Turtle, Higa is about to hack into the main control room to restore Kirito's Fluctlight when Yanai points a gun at him.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 40 is the fortieth episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on August 1, 2020. Plot. Yanai reveals his true colors as a traitor who collaborated with the Americans, Sugou and Administrator. He admits that he was in love with Administrator and wanted to avenge her death by killing Kirito, who had foiled her plans. Meanwhile, Kikuoka and Rinko find out that Yanai was the one who planted code 871 in UW and exposed his treachery. In UW, Subtlizer gains the upper hand over Sinon but she is rescued by her bond with Kirito, while Sheyta and Iskahn face certain death along with the remaining pugilists until Leafa and Lilpilin show up with the Orc army to save them. The ALO players try to persuade the Chinese and Korean players that they were misled but Vassago interferes and silences them. In the end, Asuna and the others give up to protect the UW inhabitants and Vassago identifies himself as PoH to Asuna, confessing that he was the mastermind behind the Laughing Coffin massacre in SAO and that he wanted Asuna, Kirito and the other frontliners to become killers. He then demands that Kirito be brought to him, despite Asuna's protests. Elsewhere, the old SAO server activates.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 41 is the forty-first episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on August 8, 2020. Plot. As the server begins to reboot, Vassago prepares to deliver the final blow to Kirito. However, his attack is interrupted by the arrival of Eiji and Yuna, who come to Kirito's aid. Eiji engages Vassago in combat, seeking revenge for his fallen comrades from SAO who were killed by Laughing Coffin. However, he is no match for Vassago's overwhelming strength and skill, and he is soon defeated. Yuna manages to rescue him and escape from the battlefield. Meanwhile, two of the red players who are allied with Vassago recognize him as one of the Laughing Coffin members who terrorized SAO. They try to warn their fellow players about his true identity and intentions, but they are ignored and dismissed. Vassago then uses his special ability to manipulate the emotions of the red players, making them turn against each other in a frenzy of bloodlust. Vassago's hatred toward Japanese people had a deep-rooted origin. His father was a Japanese man who had an affair with his mother, and left them both when he was born. Years later, his father reappeared, not to apologize or reconnect, but to beg him to donate a kidney to his half-brother, who was his legitimate son. Vassago felt betrayed and disgusted by his father's selfishness and hypocrisy. He decided to take revenge on him and all Japanese people by stealing a Nerve Gear and joining SAO, knowing that he could die or be trapped there. He didn't care about the risks, as long as he could slaughter as many Japanese players as possible. Subtlizer gains the upper hand over Sinon and is about to finish her off, but she manages to counterattack and injure him severely, forcing him to flee. Meanwhile, Leafa faces a swarm of red players and fights valiantly until she collapses from exhaustion. On the Ocean Turtle, Rinko intervenes and throws a wrench at Yanai, who falls to his death from the catwalk. Higa resumes his attempt to use the Fluctlights of Asuna, Sinon and Leafa to restore Kirito's damaged soul.

Sword Art Online Alicization Episode 42 is the forty-second episode of the Sword Art Online Alicization anime adaptation. It aired on August 15, 2020. Plot. As Vassago continues his ruthless rampage, Kirito remains unconscious and tormented by the traumas of his past. He is unable to wake up and face the threat that endangers all the Japanese players and the inhabitants of the Underworld. Asuna, who has been fighting bravely by his side, is almost overwhelmed by despair. But then, she hears a familiar voice in her ear: Yuuki, her dear friend who passed away. Yuuki's words fill Asuna with courage and determination, and she stands up once more to confront Vassago. She unleashes a powerful attack that almost finishes him off. But Vassago is not done yet. He draws on the energy of the surrounding area to heal himself and gain control of the red players, commanding them to join his assault. Kirito's Fluctlight is still dormant, despite the efforts of Asuna, Sinon and Leafa to revive him with their own. Higa is losing hope, until he notices a faint signal coming from Eugeo's Blue Rose Sword. It is a fragment of Eugeo's soul, that somehow remained inside the sword after his death.
